ज: ज The third letter of the second class of consonants, corresponding to the letter J in jet.

ज mfn. (जः जा जं) 1 Speedy, swift. 2 Eaten. 3 Victorious, triumphant, conquering or a conqueror. m. (-जः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 Birth, production. 4 A parent, a progenitor. 5 Poison. 6 Enjoyment. 7 Light, lustre. 8 Speed. 9 An imp, a goblin. E. जन to bear or be born, जि to conquer, or other roots, and ड aff.
जकुट: जकुट m. (-टः) 1 The Malaya mountain. 2 A dog. n. (-टं) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
जक्ष: जक्ष r. 1st cl. (जक्षति 3rd plu. जक्षति) 1 To eat. 2 To laugh. (इ) जक्षि (जंक्षते) 1 To give. 2 To go.
जक्षण: जक्षण n. (-णं) Eating. E. जक्ष to eat, affix ल्युट्.
जक्षि: जक्षि f. (-क्षिः) Eating. E. जक्ष to eat, कि aff.
जक्षिवस्: जक्षिवस् mfn. (-वान्-क्षुषी-वत्) Eating, who eats. E. जक्ष to eat, वसु aff.
जक्ष्म: जक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः) Consumption, decline: see the next.
जक्ष्मन्: जक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Consumption, phthisis. E. यक्ष to worship, and मनिन् affix; ज is substituted for the semivowel; also यक्ष्मन्, and with a final vowel जक्ष्म.
जगच्चक्षुस्: जगच्चक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun. E. जगत् the universe, and चक्षुस् the eye.
जगत्: जगत् mfn. (-गन्-गती-गत्) Moveable, loco-motive, transitory. nf, (-त्-ती) The world, the universe. m. (-त्) Air, wind. f. (-ती) 1 The earth. 2 People, mankind. 3 A sort of metre, a stanza of forty-eight syllables variously disposed so as to form thirty varieties. 4 A field of Jambu flowers. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix अति, जग substituted for the root, and ङीप् fem. affix, or गम as before, and शतृ aff.
जगतीधर: जगतीधर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. जगती, and धर what holds.
जगतीपति: जगतीपति m. (-तिः) A king, a prince. E. जगती, and पति lord.
जगतीपाल: जगतीपाल m. (-लः) A king. E. जगती, and पाल who protects.
जगतीरुह: जगतीरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. जगती, and रुह what grows.
जगत्कर्तृ: जगत्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. जगत्, and कर्त्तृ a maker, the creator of the world.
जगत्कर्त्तृ: जगत्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. जगत्, and कर्त्तृ a maker, the creator of the world.
जगत्कृत्स्न: जगत्कृत्स्न n. (-लं) The universe. E. जगत्, and कृत्स्न whole.
जगत्क्षय: जगत्क्षय m. (-यः) The destruction of the world. E. जगत्, and क्षय loss.
जगत्त्रय: जगत्त्रय n. (-यं) The three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell. E. जगत्, and त्रय three.
जगत्पति: जगत्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A king. 2 A deity. E. जगत्, and पति master.
जगत्प्राण: जगत्प्राण m. (-णः) Air, wind. E. जगत् the universe, and प्राण breath or being.
जगत्समग्र: जगत्समग्र n. (-ग्रं) The universe. E. जगत्, and समग्र whole.
जगत्सर्व: जगत्सर्व्व n. (-र्व्वं) The whole world. E. जगत्, and सर्व्व whole.
जगत्सर्व्व: जगत्सर्व्व n. (-र्व्वं) The whole world. E. जगत्, and सर्व्व whole.
जगत्साक्षिन्: जगत्साक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) The sun. E. जगत् the universe, and साक्षिन, witness, spectator.
जगत्स्रष्टृ: जगत्स्रष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) The creator of the world, BRAHMĀ. E. जगत्, and स्रष्ट creator.
जगदन्त: जगदन्त m. (-न्तः) The end of the world. E. जगत्, and अन्त end.
जगदम्बा: जगदम्बा f. (-म्बा) A name of DURGĀ. E. जगत्, and अम्बा mother.
जगदात्मक: जगदात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Identical with the world. E. जगत्, and आत्मक same.
जगदात्मन्: जगदात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The supreme spirit. E. जगत्, and आत्मन् the soul.
जगदाधार: जगदाधार m. (-रः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A stay or supporter of the universe. E. जगत् the world, and आधार support.
जगदीश: जगदीश m. (-शः) An epithet of VIṢṆU. E. जगत् the universe, and ईश lord.
जगदेकपावन: जगदेकपावन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Purifying or sanctifying the world. E. जगत्, एक chief, and पावन purifying.
जगद्गौरी: जगद्गौरी f. (-री) A name of MANASĀDEVĪ, the deified wife of the sage JARATKĀRU, and sister to the Nāgas or serpent race. E. जगत् the world, and गौरी the goddess GAURĪ; a terrestrial GAURĪ; her relationship to the snake breed is supposed to give her an influence over them, which is implored frequently by the Hindus.
जगद्घातिन्: जगद्घातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Destroying the world, destructive, hostile to mankind. E. जगत्, and घातिन् who destroys.
जगद्धात्री: जगद्धात्री f. (-त्री) A name of DURGĀ. E. जगत्, and घात्री a nurse.
जगद्वल: जगद्वल m. (-लः) Air, wind. E. जगत् the universe, and वल surrounding.
जगद्योनि: जगद्योनि m. (-निः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-निः) The earth. E. जगत् the universe, and योनि womb, or place of production.
जगद्वहा: जगद्वहा f. (-हा) The earth. E. जगत् the universe, and वह what bears.
जगद्विनाश: जगद्विनाश m. (-शः) The expiration of a Yuga or period of the world's existence. E. जगत् the world, and विनाश destruction.
जगनु: जगनु m. (-नुः) 1 Fire or its deity. 2 An animal or insect. E. गम to go, deriv. irr.
जगन्नाथ: जगन्नाथ m. (-थः) A form of VIṢṆU. E. जगत् the universe, and नाथ lord; a peculiar and celebrated idol of this name is worshipped on the Coromandel coast, in Orissa, and pilgrimages are made to the shrine of JAGANNĀTHA from all parts of India.
जगन्नाथक्षेत्र: जगन्नाथक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The shrine of JAGANNĀTHA and surrounding district. E. जगन्नाथ, and क्षेत्र holy place.
जगन्निवास: जगन्निवास m. (-सः) 1 Worldly existence. 2 A deity, as VIṢṆU, in whom the world exists. E. जगत्, and निवास abode.
जगन्नु: जगन्नु m. (-न्नुः) 1 Fire. 2 An animal. E. जगत्, and नु to send, कु affix; also जगनु.
जगन्मातृ: जगन्मातृ f. (-ता) A name of DURGĀ. E. जमत्, and मातृ mother.
जगन्वस्: जगन्वस् mfn. (-वान्-नुषी-न्वत्) Who or what goes. E. गम to go, वसु affix, root repeated.
जगर: जगर m. (-रः) Armour, mail. E. जागृ to awaken, अच् affix, deriv. irr.; also जागर.
जगल: जगल m. (-लः) 1 Vinous liquor for distilling. 2 Armour: see the preceding. E. गल to ooze, अच् affix, and the root reduplicated; otherwise ल interchanged with रः see जगर.
जग्ध: जग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Eaten. n. (-ग्धं) Food. E. अद to eat, affix क्त, and जग्ध substituted for the regular form.
जग्धि: जग्धि f. (-ग्धिः) 1 Eating. 2 Eating, together or in company. 3 Food, victuals. E. अद to eat, क्तिन् affix, and जग्धि substituted.
जग्मि: जग्मि m. (-ग्मिः) Air, wind. E. गम to go, कि affix, root reiterated, and form irr.
जग्मिवस्: जग्मिवस् mfn. (-वान्-ग्मुषी-वत्) Who or what goes. E. गम to go, वसु affix, इट् inserted.
जघन: जघन n. (-नं) 1 Mons veneris. 2 The hip and loins. E. हन to kill or hurt, जवन substituted for the radical, and अच Uṇādi aff.
जघनकूपक: जघनकूपक m. du. (-कौ) The hollows of the loins of a handsome woman. E. जघन the loins, and कूपक a well or pit.
जघनचपला: जघनचपला f. (-ला) 1 A woman active as in dancing. 2 A species of the Aryā metre.
जघनेफला: जघनेफला f. (-ला) Opposite leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositi-folia, Rox.) E. जघन the haunch, &c. here put for the stem, and फल fruit; growing round the stem.
जघन्य: जघन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Last, hindmost. 2 Low, vile, base. 3 Worst, vilest, lowest. n. (-न्यं) The penis. m. (-न्यः) A Śūdra or man of the fourth tribe. E. जघन the loins, &c. and यत् aff.
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्थ: जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Vile, addicted to low pursuits. E. जघन्य vile, गुण quality, वृत्ति practice, and स्थ standing.
जघन्यज: जघन्यज m. (-जः) 1 A Śūdra. 2 A younger brother or younger born. E. जघन्य last, and ज born.
जघन्वस्: जघन्वस् mfn. (-वान्-नुषी-न्वत्) Who or what kills. E. हन to kill, वसु affix, root repeated.
जघ्नि: जघ्नि m. (-घ्निः) A sharp or offensive weapon. E. हन to kill, affix कि, form irr.
जघ्नु: जघ्नु mfn. (-घ्नुः-घ्नुः-घ्नु) Striking, beating, injuring, one who does so. E. हन to hurt or kill, कु affix, and the radical reiterated.
जघ्मिवस्: जघ्मिवस् mfn. (-वान्-घ्मुषी-वत्) Killing, who or what kills. E. हन to kill, वसु affix, root repeated, इट् inserted.
जङ्गम: जङ्गम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Locomotive, moveable, that which has motion as opposed to that which is stationary. E. गम to go, affix अच्, and the radical reduplicated.
जङ्गमकुटी: जङ्गमकुटी f. (-टी) A parasol, a catta or umbrella. E. जङ्गम moveable, and कुटी a house.
जङ्गल: जङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Desert, solitary, waste, jungle, wild, &c. n. (-लं) Flesh. E. जङ्ग for जङ्गम moveable, and ल what brings or takes, i. e. appertaining to moveable beings, as beasts, birds, &c.
जङ्गाल: जङ्गाल m. (-लः) A land mark, a limit, a boundary, a ridge of earth running along the edge of a field for collecting water, and forming a passage over it. E. जङ्ग locomotion, and ल what makes, आङ् prefixed, with the sense of limitation.
जङ्गुल: जङ्गुल n. (-लं) Poison, venom. E. जङ्गु locomotive, (an animal,) and ल what destroys, from लु to cut, affix ड.
जङ्घा: जङ्घा f. (-ङ्घा) The leg. E. जन to be born, जङ्घ substituted for the radical, and अच् aff.
जङ्घाकारिक: जङ्घाकारिक m. (-कः) A courier, a runner, an express. E. जङ्घा a leg, and कर a toll, affix ठन; who levies a toll by his legs.
जङ्घाचाण: जङ्घाचाण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves. E. जङ्घा the leg, and त्राण what preserves.
जङ्घाल: जङ्घाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Quick, rapid, going quickly. m. (-लः) 1 A courier. 2 A deer, an antelope. E. जङ्घा the leg, and अल able, stout.
जज: जज r. 1st cl. (जजति) also (इ) जजि (जंजति) To fight.
जज m. (-जः) A warrior. E. जज to fight, and अच् aff.
जजौजस्: जजौजस् n. (-जः) Prowess, valour. E. जज, and ओजस् power.
जञ्जपूक: जञ्जपूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Muttering repeatedly. 2 Muttering evil prayers or charms. m. (-कः) An ascetic, a devotee, one who does so. E. जप to mutter, reiterative form, वुन् aff.
जट: जट r. 1st cl. (जटति) To clot, to be entangled, as hair.
जटा: जटा f. (-टा) 1 The hair matted as worn by the god ŚIVA, and by ascetics; the long hairs occasionally clotted together, and brought over the head so as to project like a horn from the forehead, at other times allowed to fall carelessly over the back and shoulders. 2 The root of a tree, a fibrous root. 3 Spikenard: see जटामांसी. 4 A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) 5 Cowach. 6 Hedysarum, various species. E. जट to entangle, अच् affix; or जन to be produced, टन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical final rejected.
जटाजूट: जटाजूट m. (-टः) 1 A quantity of clotted hair. 2 ŚIVA'S hair. E. जटा, and जूट the same.
जटाज्वाल: जटाज्वाल m. (-लः) A lamp. E. जटा entangled hair, and ज्वाला flame.
जटाटङ्क: जटाटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) ŚIVA. E. जटा as above, टकि to bind, affix अच्.
जटाटीर: जटाटीर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. E. जटा as above, अट to go, and ईरन् affix; some copies read जटाचीर.
जटाधर: जटाधर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A Jina or Jaina deified saint. 3 Any mendicant wearing the braid of hair. E. जटा entangled hair, and धर possessor; also with धारिन्, जटाधारिन् (-री.)
जटामांसी: जटामांसी f. (-सी) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) E. जटा, entangled hair or root, and मांसी the same plant.
जटायु: जटायु m. (-युः) 1 A fabulous bird, the son of ARUṆA, killed by RĀVAṆA. 2 Bdellium. E. जटा accumulation, आयु or आयुस् life; long-lived; hence also जटायुस् m. (-युः)
जटाल: जटाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wearing clotted hair. m. (-लः) The Indian fig tree. 2 Zedoary. 3 Bdellium. f. (-ला) Spikenard: see जटामांसी. E. जटा as above, and लच् affix of possession.
जटावत्: जटावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having clotted hair. f. (-ती) Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansie.) E. जटा, and मतुप् aff.
जटि: जटि f. (-टिः) 1 Waved-leaf fig tree, (F. venosa:) see जटिन. 2 Assemblage, multitude. 2 Clotted hair: see जटा. E. जट to collect, affix इन्.
जटिन्: जटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Having clotted hair. m. (-टी) Wavedleaf fig tree: see जटि. E. जटा as above, and इनि aff.
जटिल: जटिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having any clotted or entangled hair. m. (-लः) A lion. f. (-ला) 1 Indian spikenard. 2 Long pepper. 3 Orris. E. जटा, and इलच् aff.
जटी: जटी f. (-टी) Waved-leaf fig tree: see जटि. E. जट to entangle, इ Uṇādi affix, and ङीष् added.
जटुल: जटुल m. (-लः) A freckle, a mark. E. जट to accumulate, उलच् affix; also जडुल.
जठर: जठर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hard, firm. 2 Bound, tied. mn. (-रः-रं) The belly. E. जम to eat, अर Uṇādi affix, and ठच् substituted for the radical final.
जठरज्वाला: जठरज्वाला f. (-ला) Belly-ache, colic, enteritis. E. जठर, and ज्वाला burning.
जठरनुद्: जठरनुद् m. (-नुत्) Cassia fistula. E. जठर the belly, and नुद् a laxative.
जठरयन्त्रणा: जठरयन्त्रणा f. (-णा) Pain endured by the child before birth. E. जठर, and यन्त्रणा punishing; for misdeeds in a preceding birth.
जठरयातना: जठरयातना f. (-ना) Pain of the child in the womb: see the preceding. E. जठर, and यातना pain.
जठरव्यथा: जठरव्यथा f. (-था) Colic. E. जठर, and व्यथा pain.
जठरस्थ: जठरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Being in the belly. 2 Being in the womb. E. जठर, and स्थ what stays; also जठरस्थित, and जठरस्थायिन्, &c.
जठरामय: जठरामय m. (-यः) Dropsy, water in the abdomen. E. जठर the belly, and आमय sickness.
जड: जड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) 1 Cold, frigid, chilly. 2 Stupid, apathetic, idiotic. 3 Dumb. n. (-डं) 1 Water: see जल. 2 Lead. f. (-डा) Cowach. m. (-डः) 1 Cold, frost, winter. 2 Idiocy, fatuity, stupidity. 3 Dulness, apathy, sluggishness of mind or body. E. जल to heap or accumulate, affix अच्, and ल changed to ड.
जडक्रिय: जडक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dilatory, working slowly. E. जड apathetic, and क्रिया business, affix ड.
जडता: जडता f. (-ता) 1 Coldness, chilliness. 2 Apathy, stupidity. 3 Stupefaction, despair. E. जड, as above, and तल् affix of the abstract; also with त्व, जडत्वं.
जडिमन्: जडिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Stupefaction, insensibility. 2 Stupidity, dulness. 3 Frigidity. E. जड cold, &c. इमनिच् aff.
जडीकृत: जडीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Paralysed, rendered cold, torpid or insensible, confounded. E. जड, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
जडीभूत: जडीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stupefied, paralysed, become torpid, dull, or insensible. E. जड, and भूत been, च्चि aug.
जडुल: जडुल m. (-लः) A freckle, a mark. E. जल to accumulate, उलच् affix, and ल changed to ड.
जतु: जतु n. (-तु) Lac, a red dye or animal pigment, analogous to cochineal. E. जन to be born, उ Uṇādi affix, and न changed to त; also with कन् added जतुक.
जतुक: जतुक n. (-कं) 1 Lac: see the last. 2 Asafoetida. f. (-का) 1 A plant, commonly Chakawat: 2 A bat; also जतूका. 3 A fragrant substance. E. कन् added to the preceding.
जतुकृत्: जतुकृत् m. (-कृत्) A fragrant substance: see the last. E. जतु lac, and कृत what makes or affords; the lac insect building its nest in this tree.
जतुपुत्त्रक: जतुपुत्त्रक m. (-कः) A man at chess or backgammon, &c. E. जतु lac, and पुत्त्रक as it were, a son, being coloured with lac.
जतुमणि: जतुमणि m. (-णिः) A mole, a natural mark on the body. E. जतु, and मणि a gem.
जतुरस: जतुरस m. (-सः) Lac, the dye. E. जतु, and रस juice.
जतूका: जतूका f. (-का) 1 A fragrant substance. 2 A bat. E. जन to be born, ऊकच् affix, and न changed to त; also with the pen. short जतुका.
जत्रु: जत्रु n. (-त्रु) The collar bone, the clavicle. E. जन to be born. Uṇādi affix रु, and न changed to त; also with कन added जत्रुक n. (-कं).
जत्वश्मक: जत्वश्मक n. (-कं) Red arsenic. E. जतु, and अश्म a stone, कन् affix, like a stone of lac.
जन: जन r. 3rd cl. but peculiar to the Vedas (जजन्ति;) also (ई) जनी r. 4th cl. (जयते) 1 To be born or produced. r. 10th cl. (जनयति) To generate or beget.

जन m. (-नः) 1 Man, individually or collectively, a man, mankind. 2 The universe. 3 A division of the universe or Loka, the residence of deified mortals: see जनलोक. 4 A low man, a wretch. f. (-नी) A mother, &c. see जनि. f. (-ना) Birth, production. E. जन to be born, affix अच्.
जनक: जनक m. (-कः) A father, a progenitor. 2 The name of a king, sovereign of Mithilā, and father of SĪTĀ. E. जन to be born, and ण्वुल् aff.
जनकता: जनकता f. (-ता) The property of generation, productiveness, paternity. E. जनक, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जनकत्वं.
जनकात्मजा: जनकात्मजा f. (-जा) A name of SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA. E. जनक as above, and आत्मजा daughter; also similar compounds, as जनकतनया, जनकसुता, &c.
जनङ्गम: जनङ्गम m. (-मः) A Caṇḍāla, a man of a low or degraded tribe. E. जन a mean man, and गम to go, खच् aff.
जनता: जनता f. (-ता) 1 Mankind, a number of men. 2 Manhood. 3 Generation, birth. E. जन a man, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जनत्वं.
जनत्रा: जनत्रा f. (-त्रा) An umbrella or parasol. E. जन the person, and त्रा saving; from sun and rain.
जनन: जनन n. (-नं) 1 Birth, production. 2 Family, race, lineage. f. (-नी) 1 A mother. 2 Tenderness, compassion. 3 A plant, commonly Chakawat; also जननि and जनी. 4 A bat. 5 Arabian jasmin. 6 Valerian. mf. (-नः-नी) A parent, a progenitor. E. जन to bear or be born, affix ल्युट्, and ङीष्.
जननि: जननि f. (-निः) 1 A fragrant plant: see the preceding. 2 Birth, production. E. जन to be born, affix अनि.
जनपद: जनपद m. (-दः) 1 Any inhabited country. 2 Man, mankind. E. जन man, and पद going.
जनप्रवाद: जनप्रवाद m. (-दः) Rumour, report. E. जन man, and प्रवाद speech, from वद to speak, with प्र prefixed, and घञ् aff.
जनप्रिय: जनप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Agreeable to mankind. 2 Philanthropic. m. (-यः) 1 Coriander seed. 2 A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera.) E. जन, and प्रिय fond of.
जनमेजय: जनमेजय m. (-यः) 1 The name of a king, son and successor to PARĪKṢIT. 2 A son of PURU. E. जन in the second case, the world, एजृ to shine, affix खश्.
जनयत्: जनयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Begetting, engendering, producing. E. जन to be born, causal form, शतृ aff.
जनयितृ: जनयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Generating, begetting, producing, who or what does so. m. (-ता) A father, a progenitor. f. (-त्री) A mother. E. जन in the causal form, to give birth, to engender, affix तृच्.
जनरव: जनरव m. (-वः) 1 Rumour, report. 2 Calumny, scandal. E. जन, and रव sound.
जनलोक: जनलोक m. (-कः) One of the seven Lokas or divisions of the world, the fifth, next above MAHARLOKA, where the sons of BRAHMĀ, and other pious men, reside. E. जन man, and लोक a world.
जनवल्लभ: जनवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Kind to or fond of mankind. E. जन, and वल्लभ a friend.
जनवाद: जनवाद m. (-दः) News, rumour, report. E. जन man, and वाद speech: see जनप्रवाद.
जनश्रुति: जनश्रुति f. (-तिः) News, tidings, intelligence. E. जन mankind, and श्रुति that which is heard.
जनस्थान: जनस्थान n. (-नं) The forest Daṇḍaka, (in the Dekhin,) the eastern part of it. E. जन a world, and स्थान a place; the resort of a world of demons.
जनाचार: जनाचार m. (-रः) Propriety, decorum, good conduct. E. जन mankind, and आचार moral observance.
जनातिग: जनातिग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Superior, superhuman. E. जन, and अतिग going beyond.
जनाधिनाथ: जनाधिनाथ m. (-थः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A king. E. जन, and अधिनाथ supreme lord.
जनाव्: जनाव् m. (-नौः) A preserver or protector of mankind. E. जन, and अव to preserve, क्विन् aff.
जनान्त: जनान्त m. (-न्तः) A district, an inhabited country. E. जन man, and अन्त boundary.
जनान्तिक: जनान्तिक n. (-क्रं) Secret communication, whispering, speaking aside, &c. E. जन man, and अन्तिक near.
जनार्दन: जनार्द्दन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. जन mankind, and अर्द्दन worshipping; whom men worship.
जनार्द्दन: जनार्द्दन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. जन mankind, and अर्द्दन worshipping; whom men worship.
जनाशन: जनाशन m. (-नः) A wolf. E. जन, and अशन food.
जनाश्रय: जनाश्रय m. (-यः) A temporary hall. E. जन man, and आश्रय an asylum.
जनि: जनि f. (-निः or -नी) 1 A woman in general. 2 A mother. 3 Birth, production. 4 The wife of a son, or brother's son, &c. 5 A fragrant plant; see जतूका. E. जन to be born or to bear, Uṇādi affix इन्, and optionally ङीष् added.
जनिक: जनिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Producing. f. (-का) A woman, a wife, a mother.
जनित: जनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Engendered, begotten. 2 Occasioned, occurring, produced. E. जन to be born, causal form, क्त aff.
जनितस्वन: जनितस्वन m. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding, making a noise. E. जनित, स्वन sound.
जनितृ: जनितृ m. (-ता) A father. f. (-त्री) A mother. E. जन to be born, (from whom,) तृच् affix; and इट् inserted.
जनितोद्यम: जनितोद्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Vigorous, energetic, making exertion. E. जनित, and उद्यम effort.
जनित्व: जनित्व m. (-त्वः) A father. f. (-त्वा) A mother. E. जन to be born, (from whom,) and इत्व Uṇādi aff.
जनिमन्: जनिमन् m. (-मा) Birth, engenderment. E. जन to be born, इमन् Uṇādi aff.
जनीन: जनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Appropriate, good for, suitable. E. जन, and ख aff.
जनु: जनु f. (-नुः) Birth. E. जन to be born, उ Uṇādi affix; also with ऊ affix जनू, f. (-नूः)
जनुस्: जनुस् n. (-नुः) Birth. E. जन to be born, Uṇādi affix उसि.
जनेष्ट: जनेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Desired or prized by mankind. f. (-ष्टा) Turmeric. E. जन, and इष्ट wished.
जनोदाहरण: जनोदाहरण n. (-णं) Fame, glory. E. जन mankind, and उदाहरण pre-eminence.
जनौघ: जनौघ n. (-घं) A multitude, a mob. E. जन, and ओघ a heap.
जन्तु: जन्तु m. (-न्तुः) Any animal, any being endowed with animal life; it is more usually applied however to beings of the lowest organization. E. जन to be born, तु Uṇādi aff.
जन्तुकम्बु: जन्तुकम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A shell, a snail's shell, &c. E. जन्तु, and कम्बु a shell.
जन्तुका: जन्तुका f. (-का) Lac. E. कन् added to जन्त
जन्तुघ्न: जन्तुघ्न nf. (-घ्नं-घ्नी) 1 A plant, and vermifuge: see विडङ्ग. 2 Asafoetida. m. (-घ्नः) A citron. E. जन्तु an animal, (a worm,) and घ्न what destroys.
जन्तुनाशन: जन्तुनाशन n. (-नं) Asafœtida. E. जन्तु, and नाशन destroying.
जन्तुफल: जन्तुफल m. (-लः) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.) E. जन्तु an animal, and फल a leaf; its leaves swarm with insects.
जन्तुला: जन्तुला f. (-ला) A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. जन्तु an animal or insect, and ला what gets.
जन्मकील: जन्मकील m. (-लः) VIṢṆU. E. जन्म birth, and कील the stay.
जन्मद: जन्मद m. (-दः) A father. E. जन्म birth, and द who gives.
जन्मन्: जन्मन् n. (-न्म) Birth, production. E. जन to be born, and मनिन् Uṇādi affix, or with a final vowel जन्म.
जन्मनक्षत्र: जन्मनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) The planet or constellation under which a person is born. E. जन्म, and नक्षत्र asterism.
जन्मभूमि: जन्मभूमि f. (-मिः) Native country, birthplace. E. जन्म, and भूमि land.
जन्मवत्: जन्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Mortal, living. E. जन्म, and मतुप् aff.
जन्मवर्त्मन्: जन्मवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The vulva. E. जन्म birth, and वर्त्मन् path or way.
जन्मवैलक्षण्य: जन्मवैलक्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) Acting contrary to one's origin, unbecoming one's birth, &c. E. जन्म, and वैलक्षण्य inconsistency.
जन्मशोधन: जन्मशोधन n. (-नं) Acquitting the obligations derived from birth. E. जन्म, and शोधन wiping away.
जन्मसाफल्य: जन्मसाफल्य n. (-ल्यं) Attainment of the object or end of existence. E. जन्म, and साफल्य fruitfulness.
जन्मान्तर: जन्मान्तर n. (-रं) 1 The other world. 2 Regeneration, another birth. E. जन्म, and अन्तर difference.
जन्मान्ध: जन्मान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Blind from birth. E. जन्म, and अन्ध blind.
जन्माष्टमी: जन्माष्टमी f. (-मी) The eighth lunation or dark half of Bhadra, the birth day of KṚṢṆA. E. जन्म, and अष्टमी eighth.
जन्मिन्: जन्मिन् m. (-न्मी) An animal, an existent being. E. जन्म birth, and इनि aff.
जन्मेजय: जन्मेजय m. (-यः) The name of a prince: see जनमेजय.
जन्य: जन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 To be born or produced. 2 Fit for or favourable to men. m. (-न्यः) 1 A father. The friend, attendant, or companion of a bridegroom. f. (-न्या) The friend of a mother. 2 The relation or companion of a bride, a bridesmaid, &c. 3 Pleasure, happiness. 4 Affection. 5 A mother. n. (-न्यं) 1 War, combat. 2 Rumour, report. 3 A market, a fair. 4 A portent, one occurring at birth. E. जन to be born, &c. affix यत्, or Uṇādi affix युक्.
जन्यु: जन्यु m. (-न्युः) 1 An animal, an existent and sentient being. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 Fire or Agni. E. जन to be born, &c. Uṇādi affix युच्.
जप: जप r. 1st cl. (जपति) 1 To speak, to say or tell. 2 To meditate, to speak internally, to say to one's self. With उप prefixed, To divide.

जप m. (-पः) Muttering prayers, repeating inaudibly passages from the scriptures, charms, names of a deity, counting silently the beads of a rosary, &c. f. (-पा) The China rose, the flower or plant; also जवा. E. जप to repeat inaudibly, affix अप्; the flower is a sacred object.
जपन: जपन n. (-नं) Inaudible repetition of prayers, &c.: see the last. E. जप as before, affix ल्युट्.
जपनीय: जपनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be meditated on, to be repeated inaudibly. E. जप, and अनीयर् aff.
जपपरायण: जपपरायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Devoted to religious meditation, engaged in muttering prayers, &c. E. जप as above, and परायण adhering or attached to.
जपमाला: जपमाला f. (-ला) A rosary. E. जप, and माला a string of beads, &c.
जपयज्ञ: जपयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Muttering prayers as a religious rite or sacrifice. E. जप, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
जपित्वा: जपित्वा ind. Having repeated inaudibly. E. जप, and क्त्वा affix, इट inserted.
जपित: जपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Repeated inaudibly. E. जप to mutter prayers, and क्त aff.
जप्त्वा: जप्त्वा ind. Having repeated inaudibly. E. जप, and क्त्वा affix: see जपित्वा; the omission of इट् is unusual.
जप्य: जप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be repeated inaudibly, to be said over repeatedly, (a prayer, &c.) E. जप, and यत् aff.
जभ्: जभ् r. 1st cl. (जभति-ते) also (इ) जभि r. 1st cl. (जम्भति-ते) 1 To gape or yawn. 2 To copulate. r. 10th cl. (जम्भयते) To destroy, to efface.
जम: जम (उ) जमु r. 1st cl. (जमति) To eat; also चम.
जम्: जम् ind. A wife. It is used in composition: see जम्पती.
जमदग्नि: जमदग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Muni, the father of PARAŚURĀMA.
जमन: जमन n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food, victuals. E. जम to eat, affix ल्युट्.
जम्पती: जम्पती m. du. (-ती) Husband and wife. E. जं for जाया a wife, and पति a husband: see दम्पती, &c.
जम्बाल: जम्बाल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Mud, clay. 2 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria,) &c. m. (-लः) A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. जल water, बल to move, affix अण्, and the deriv. irr.
जम्बालिनी: जम्बालिनी f. (-नी) A river. E. जम्बाल mud, इनि and ङीष् affs.
जम्बिर: जम्बिर m. (-रः) A lime: see the next.
जम्बीर: जम्बीर m. (-रः) 1 Common lime, (Citrus acida;) the name seems to be applied to more than one species. 2 A plant, called by some a sort of basil, with small leaves; also जम्भीर, and जम्बिर. E. जम to eat, ईरन् affix, and बुक् augment.
जम्बु: जम्बु mn. (-म्बुः-म्बु) 1 Jambu Dvīpa, said to be so named from the Jambu tree abounding in it, and implying, according to the Purāṇas, the central division of the world, or the known world: according to the Bauddhas, it is confined to India. 2 A fabulous river, said to flow from the mountain Meru. f. (-म्बुः) A fruit tree, the rose apple, (Eugenia jambolana;) also applied to every species of Eugenia. fn. (-म्बुः-म्बु) The fruit. E. जम to eat, बुक् augment, and कु or कू Uṇādi affix; hence it is also written जम्बूः.
जम्बुक: जम्बुक m. (-कः) 1 A jackall. 2 The deity of water, VARUṆA. 3 A low man. 4 The rose apple. E. जम to eat, affix उकच् and वुक् augment, eating flesh, &c. or जम्बु as above, and कन् added; the affix also being ऊकच्, जम्बूक.
जम्बुद्वीप: जम्बुद्वीप m. (-पः) One of the divisions of the world. E. द्वीप a continent, added to जम्बु.
जम्बुमत्: जम्बुमत् m. (-मान्) 1 A monkey. 2 A mountain. f. (-मती) An Apsarā or heavenly nymph.
जम्बूल: जम्बूल m. (-लः) 1 A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) 2 The rose apple. n. (-लं) Jokes addressed to the bridegroom by his female relatives and friends. E. जम्बू as above, and ल what gets or is.
जम्बूलमालिका: जम्बूलमालिका f. (-का) Compliments or jokes addressed to the bride and bridegroom. E. जम्बूल, and मालिका a string.
जम्भ: जम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A tooth. 2 The lime. 3 Food, victuals. 4 The chin. 5 A quiver. 6 A part, a portion. 7 The name of a demon. E. जभि to destroy, affix अच्.
जम्भक: जम्भक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Who or what yawns, opens, expands, &c. 2 Who or what kills or destroys. m. (-कः) A lime or citron. f. (-का) Yawning. E. जभि to yawn, &c. ण्वुल् aff.
जम्भद्विष्: जम्भद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A name of INDRA. 2 A demon. E. जम्भ a demon, and द्विष् a foe; also similar compounds.
जम्भभेदिन्: जम्भभेदिन् m. (-दी) INDRA. E. जम्भ as above, and भेदिन् destroying: see the last.
जम्भर: जम्भर m. (-रः) A lime or citron. E. see the next, ल being changed to र.
जम्भल: जम्भल m. (-लः) 1 A lime or citron. 2 A Jina or deified Jaina saint. f. (-ला) A female Rākṣasī, the worship of whom is supposed to procure for women procreation. E. जभि to destroy, (sickness, sin, &c.) कलच् aff.
जम्भारि: जम्भारि m. (-रिः) 1 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 2 Fire or its deity. 3 INDRA. E. जम्भ the demon, and अरि a foe.
जम्भिन्: जम्भिन् m. (-म्भी) A lime or citron. E. जभि to destroy, (disease,) affix इनि.
जम्भीर: जम्भीर m. (-रः) 1 The lime or citron, apparently of more than one species. 2 A plant, considered to be a kind of basil with small leaves. E. जभि to destroy, (sickness,) ईरन् affix, and नुम् augment; also जम्बीर, &c.
जय: जय m. (-यः) 1 Conquest, victory, triumph. 2 A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. 3 A proper name, the son of INDRA. 4 One of VIṢṆU'S doorkeepers. 5 The name of a king; also विजयनन्दन. 6 A kind of Mūṅg or bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) f. (-या) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ. 2 One of her female companions. 3 The 3rd, 8th, or 13th lunar day of either half month. 4 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 5 A plant: see जयन्ती. 6 A tree, commonly Ganiyari, (Premna spinosa.) 7 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 8 A banner, a flag. E. जि to conquer or excel, affixes अच् and टाप्.
जयकोलाहल: जयकोलाहल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of dice. 2 Shouts of victory. E. जय victory, कोलाहल a noise.
जयगर्व: जयगर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride of conquest, exultation. E. जय, and गर्व्व pride.
जयगर्व्व: जयगर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride of conquest, exultation. E. जय, and गर्व्व pride.
जयत्: जयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Conquering, excelling. E. जि to conquer, शतृ aff.
जयढक्का: जयढक्का f. (-क्का) A large kettle drum. E. जय, and ढक्का a drum.
जयदत्त: जयदत्त m. (-त्तः) The son of INDRA. E. जय victory, दत्त given, to whom victory is given by his enemies.
जयद्रथ: जयद्रथ m. (-थः) A chief in the army of DURYODHANA.
जयन: जयन n. (-नं) 1 Armour for cavalry, elephants, &c. 2 Conquering, subduing. f. (-नी) INDRA'S daughter. E. जि to conquer or excel, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.
जयनयुज्: जयनयुज् mfn. (-युक्) 1 Caparisoned, (as a war horse.) 2 Victorious. E. जयन, and युज् having.
जयन्त: जयन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A hero and demigod, the son of INDRA. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 The moon. 4 A name of BHĪMA. (-न्ती) 1 A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.) 2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. 3 The daughter of INDRA. 4 A flag, a banner. 5 A particular combination in astronomy, or the rising of the asterism ROHIṆĪ at midnight, on the 8th of the dark half of Śrāvaṇa, or in fact on the birth day of KṚṢṆA, which is then particularly sacred. 6 Blades of barley planted at the commencement of the Daśaharā, and plucked at its close. E. जि to conquer or excel, Uṇādi affix झच्, fem. affix ङीष्.
जयपत्र: जयपत्र n. (-त्रं) Record of victory or triumph; in law, the sealed and written award of the judge in favour of either party; in historical tradition, the label on the brow of a horse turned loose for the Aśvamedha sacrifice. E. जय conquest, and पत्र a leaf; also with वन added जयपत्रक.
जयपाल: जयपाल m. (-लः) 1 A name of BRAHMA. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A king, a sovereign; (it is also the appellation of several celebrated Hindu princes.) 4 A tree, (Croton tiglium.) E. जय victory, पाल who nourishes.
जयध्वनि: जयध्वनि m. (-निः) Shout of victory. E. जय, and ध्वनि sound.
जयपुत्रक: जयपुत्रक m. (-कः) A kind of dice.
जयमङ्गल: जयमङ्गल m. (-लः) The royal elephant. E. जय victory, and मङ्गल good fortune.
जययज्ञ: जययज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The Aśvamedha or sacrifice of a horse, as a mark of dominion. E. जय, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
जयवह: जयवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Conferring victory. 2 Victorious. E. जय, and वह what bears.
जयवाहिनी: जयवाहिनी f. (-नी) The wife of INDRA. E. जय conquest, and वाहिनी who bears.
जयशब्द: जयशब्द m. (-ब्दः) A shout or song of victory, or the exclamation Jaya Jaya repeated like the Io of the Greeks, as जयजयदेवहरे &c. E. जय, and शब्द sound.
जयशील: जयशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Victorious, triumphant. E. जय, and शील possessed.
जयश्री: जयश्री f. (-श्रीः) Victory, glory. E. जय, and श्री splendor.
जयान्तराय: जयान्तराय m. (-यः) An impediment or hindrance to victory. E. जय, and अन्तराय obstacle.
जयारव: जयारव m. (-वः) The Io or song of victory: see जयशब्द. E. जय, and आरव sound.
जयावह: जयावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Victorious. 2 Conferring victory. E. जय, and आवह what gives.
जयिन्: जयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Victorious. E. जय victory, इनि aff.
जयोद्धुर: जयोद्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Victorious, conquering. E. जय, and उद्धुर firm.
जय्य: जय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Able to conquer, victorious. E. जि to subdue, affix यत्, deriv. irr.
जय्यता: जय्यता f. (-ता) Victory, success, ability to conquer. E. जय्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जय्यत्वं.
जरठ: जरठ mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं) 1 Hard, solid. 2 Hard-hearted, harsh, cruel. 3 Pale, yellowish-white. 4 Old, decayed, infirm. 5 Bent, bowed down, drooping. m. (-ठः) Decrepitude. E. जॄ to become old or decayed, Uṇādi affix अठ, and the deriv. irr.
जरण: जरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Old, infirm, decayed. m. (-णः) 1 Cuminseed. 2 A plant yielding a pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) 3 A sort of salt, (Bit-lobon or Bit-lavaṇa.) 4 Old age, becoming old and infirm. n. (-णं) Asafœtida. E. जॄ to become old, affix युच्.
जरण्ड: जरण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Old, decayed. E. जॄ to be old, अण्डच् Uṇādi aff.
जरत्: जरत् mfn. (-रन्-रती-रत्) 1 Old, ancient, advanced in years. 2 Infirm, decayed. m. (-रन्) An old man. f. (-ती) An old woman. E. जॄ to be or become old, participial affix शतृ.
जरत्कारु: जरत्कारु m. (-रुः) A celebrated Muni or sage so named. f. (-रुः) The wife of JARATKĀRU, the snake goddess MANASĀ. E. जरत् being old, and कारु a maker; a practiser of austerities in old age.
जरत्कारुप्रिया: जरत्कारुप्रिया f. (-या) The goddess MANASĀ, exercising a peculiar power over serpents, as the sister of VĀSUKI, the Nāga. E. जरत्कारु as above, and प्रिया the beloved.
जरद्गव: जरद्गव m. (-वः) An old ox. f. (-वी) An old cow. E. जरत् old, गो a cow, affix टच्, fem. affix ङीष्.
जरन्त: जरन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A buffalo. 2 An old man. E. जृ to be or become old, Uṇādi affix झच्.
जरसान: जरसान m. (-नः) A man. E. जॄ to grow old, असानच् Uṇādi aff.
जरा: जरा f. (-रा) 1 Decrepitude, the general relaxation and debility consequent upon old age, or old age itself. 2 A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) 3 A female demon or Rākṣasī. E. जॄ to grow old, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
जरातुर: जरातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Infirm, decrepid, debilitated, old. E. जरा infirmity, and आतुर diseased, affected.
जरापरिणत: जरापरिणत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stooping, bent down with age or infirmity. E. जरा, and परिणत bent.
जरापुष्ट: जरापुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A proper name: see जरासन्ध. E. जरा a female Rākṣasī, and पुष्ट fostered; assisted at his birth by a demon.
जराभीरु: जराभीरु m. (-रुः) Love or the deity KAMA. E. जरा decrepitude, and भीरु formidable.
जरायणि: जरायणि m. (-णिः) The sovereign JARĀSANDHA. E. जरा the Rākṣasī, फिञ् affix of descent.
जरायु: जरायु m. (-युः) The womb, the uterus. E. जरा infirmity, इण् to obtain, Uṇādi affix उण्; also with a final स, जरायुस्. m. (-युः)
जरायुज: जरायुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Viviparous, born from the womb, as man and other animals. E. जरायु the womb, ज born.
जरासन्ध: जरासन्ध m. (-न्धः) A proper name, a celebrated king and warrior, sovereign of Magadha, father-in-law to KAṂSA, and foe to KṚṢṆA; he was slain in single combat by BHĪMA. E. जरा a female demon, and सन्ध connection, union; he was born in two halves, which were put together by the Rākṣasī JARĀ.
जरासन्धजित्: जरासन्धजित् m. (-जित्) BHĪMASENA, the third of the Pāṇḍu princes. E. जरासन्ध, and जित् conqueror: see the last.
जरिन्: जरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Infirm, decayed. m. (-री) An old man. E. जॄ to become old, णिनि aff.
जरुथ: जरुथ n. (-थं) 1 Flesh. 2 Skinniness, flesh flaccid with old age. E. ज to become old, उथन् Uṇādi aff.
जर्च: जर्च r. 6th cl. (जर्चति) 1 To say, to speak. 2 To reprove, to abuse or blame. 3 To threaten.
जर्च्छ: जर्च्छ r. 6th cl. (जर्च्छति) To say, to blame: see जर्च.
जर्ज: जर्ज r. 1st and 6th cls. (जर्जति) 1 To say. 2 To blame, to reprove. 3 To kill or hurt.
जर्जर: जर्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Old, infirm. 2 Split, broken. 3 Wounded, hurt. 4 Divided in parts or pieces. 5 Perforated. m. (-रः) 1 INDRA'S banner or emblem. 2 Benzoin. 3 An aquatic plant, (Utricularia fasciculata.) E. जर्ज to hurt, and अर affix; or जॄ to grow old, affix अच्, the radical repeated, and the deriv. irr.
जर्जरीक: जर्जरीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Ragged, perforated, full of holes. 2 Old, decayed. E. see the last, ईकन् aff.
जर्जरीकृत: जर्ज्जरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wounded, disabled. E. जर्जर, and कृत made, च्चि inserted.
जर्ज्जरीकृत: जर्ज्जरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wounded, disabled. E. जर्जर, and कृत made, च्चि inserted.
जर्झ: जर्झ r. 6th cl. (जर्झति) 1 To say or speak. 2 To blame. 3 To threaten.
जर्ण: जर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Old, decayed. m. (-र्णः) 1 The moon. 2 A tree. E. जॄ to grow old, न Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
जर्तिल: जर्त्तिल m. (-लः) Sesamum growing wild. E. जन to be produced, and तिल sesamum, deriv. irr.; also read जर्हिल.
जर्त्तिल: जर्त्तिल m. (-लः) Sesamum growing wild. E. जन to be produced, and तिल sesamum, deriv. irr.; also read जर्हिल.
जर्तु: जर्त्तु m. (-र्त्तुः) 1 The vulva. 2 An elephant. E. जन to be born, तु Uṇādi affix, and र inserted.
जर्त्तु: जर्त्तु m. (-र्त्तुः) 1 The vulva. 2 An elephant. E. जन to be born, तु Uṇādi affix, and र inserted.
जर्हिल: जर्हिल m. (-लः) Wild sesamum: see जर्त्तिल.
जर्त्स: जर्त्स r. 6th cl. (जर्त्सति) 1 To say or speak. 2 To blame, to censure, to abuse.
जल: जल r. 1st cl. (जलति) 1 To be sharp. 2 To be wealthy. r. 1st and 10th cls. (जलति जालयति) To cover, to hide or veil; to cover also as with a net, to encompass.

जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Cold, stupid, apathetic, idiotic, &c. n. (-लं) 1 Water. 2 A kind of perfume: see ह्रीवेर. 3 The uterus of a cow. 4 Frigidity, (moral, mental, or physical.) E. जल to hide, to encompass, &c. affix अच्; also ल being changed to its congener ड, जड q. v.
जलक: जलक n. (-कं) A conch, a shell.
जलकण्टक: जलकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 2 A crocodile. E. जल water, and कण्टक a thorn.
जलकपि: जलकपि m. (-पिः) The gangetic porpoise. E. जल, and कपि an ape, the water-ape.
जलकर: जलकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making or shedding water. m. (-रः) Rent or tax derived from water, for fisheries, &c. E. जल, and कर tax or what makes.
जलकरङ्क: जलकरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A cocoanut. 2 A shell or conch. 3 A lotus. 4 A cloud. 5 A wave. E. जल water, and करङ्क a cup or receptacle.
जलकल्क: जलकल्क m. (-ल्कः) Mud, mire. E. जल water, and कल्क sediment.
जलकाक: जलकाक m. (-कः) The diver. E. जल, and काक a crow; the water-crow.
जलकाङ्क्ष: जलकाङ्क्ष m. (-ङ्क्षः) An elephant. E. जल water, and काङ्क्ष desirous, from काक्षि with अच् affix; also with इनि affix, ut infra.
जलकाङ्क्षिन्: जलकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिनी-ङ्क्षि) Desirous of water, fond of water. m. (-क्षी) An elephant. E. जल, and काङ्क्षिन् wishing: see the last.
जलकान्तार: जलकान्तार m. (-रः) A name of VARUṆA. E. जलकान्त the water-gem, the ocean, and अर who goes or rules.
जलकिराट: जलकिराट m. (-टः) A shark, or according to some, a large alligator. E. जल water, किर a hog, and अट who goes.
जलकुक्कुटी: जलकुक्कुटी f. (-टी) The black-headed gull: see गङ्गाचिल्ली. E. जल water, and कुक्कुटी a fowl.
जलकुक्कुभ: जलकुक्कुभ m. (-भः) A sort of aquatic bird. E. जल water, and कुक्कुभ a wild fowl.
जलकुन्तल: जलकुन्तल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) E. जल water, and कुन्तल hair.
जलकुब्जक: जलकुब्जक m. (-कः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. जल, कुब्ज to be crooked, affix क्वुन्.
जलकूपी: जलकूपी f. (-पी) 1 A whirlpool. 2 A pond, a pool. 3 A spring, a well. E. जल water, कूप a well, ङीष् affix of diminution.
जलकूर्म: जलकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The gangetic porpoise. E. जल, and कूर्म्म a tortoise, a water tortoise.
जलकूर्म्म: जलकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The gangetic porpoise. E. जल, and कूर्म्म a tortoise, a water tortoise.
जलक्रिया: जलक्रिया f. (-या) A funeral ceremony, presenting water to the manes of the deceased. E. जल, and क्रिया ceremony.
जलकेश: जलकेश m. (-शः) 1 A plant, (Vallisneria.) E. जल, and केश hair; spreading over the water like dishevelled hair.
जलक्रीडा: जलक्रीडा f. (-डा) Sporting or gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure or amusement. E. जल, and क्रीडा pastime, play.
जलगुल्म: जलगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A whirlpool. 2 A turtle, a tortoise. 2 A piece of water, a lake. E. जल water, and गुल्म a lump like the spleen, or a cluster.
जलङ्ग: जलङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Aquatic, frequenting or going to water. m. (-ङ्गः) The colocynth. E. जल, and ग what goes.
जलङ्गम: जलङ्गम m. (-मः) A Caṇḍāla, an outcaste. E. जल water, and गम who goes; who goes to fish for his subsistence; also जनङ्गम q. v.
जलचर: जलचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Aquativ, amphibious, going in or into water. E. जल, and चर what goes.
जलचारिन्: जलचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Aquatic, living in or frequenting water. m. (-री) A fish. E. जल water, and चर to go, affix णिनि.
जलज: जलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Water-born, aquatic. m. (-जः) 1 A fish. 2 Any aquatic animal. n. (-जं) 1 A lotus. 2 A shell. f. (-जा) A plant; said to be a sort of bassia growing in or near water. E. जल, and ज produced.
जलजन्तु: जलजन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A fish, or any marine, aquatic, or amphibious animal. E. जल water, and जन्तु animal.
जलजन्तुका: जलजन्तुका f. (-का) A leech. E. कन्, and टाप् added to the preceding.
जलजन्मन्: जलजन्मन् n. (-न्म) A lotus. E. जल, and जन्मन् birth.
जलजिह्व: जलजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A crocodile. E. जल cold, and जिह्वा a tongue.
जलडिम्ब: जलडिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A bivalve shell. E. जल, and डिम्ब a young animal.
जलतरङ्ग: जलतरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A wave. 2 A metal cup with water, so as to produce a harmonic note like a musical glass. E. जल, and तरङ्ग a wave.
जलतापिक: जलतापिक m. (-कः) 1 The Hilsa or sable fish, (Clupanodon ilisha, HAM.) 2 Another kind of fish, commonly Caöuchi, (Cyprinus cachius, HAM.) E. जल water, तप to inflame, ठक affix; also with णिनि affix जलतापिन् m. (-पी) The Hilsa.
जलताल: जलताल m. (-लः) The Ilīśa or Hilsa fish: see the last E. जल water, तल to abide, affix घञ्.
जलत्रा: जलत्रा f. (-त्रा) An umbrella. E. जल rain, and त्रा defending, from त्रै, with ड and टाप् affs.
जलद: जलद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Giving or shedding water. m. (-दः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. जल water, and द what gives.
जलदपङ्क्ति: जलदपङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्तिः) A line or succession of clouds. E. जलद, and पङ्क्ति a line.
जलदसंहति: जलदसंहति f. (-तिः) Cloudiness, gathering of clouds. E. जलद, and संहति assemblage.
जलदागम: जलदागम m. (-मः) The rainy season. E. जलद, and आगम arrival.
जलदान: जलदान n. (-नं) Giving water. E. जल, and दान giving.
जलदाभ: जलदाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Dark, black. E. जलद a cloud, and आभ what resembles.
जलदाशन: जलदाशन m. (-मः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. जलद a cloud, and अशन imbibing, from अश to eat, affix ल्युट्.
जलधर: जलधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Holding or having water. m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 The ocean. 3 A grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. जल water, and धर containing, possessing, from धृ with अप् aff.
जलधरमाला: जलधरमाला f. (-ला) 1 A row of clouds. 2 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. जलधर, and माला a garland.
जलधि: जलधि m. (-धिः) 1 The ocean. 2 A large number, (a hundred lacs of crores.) E. जल water, धा to have, and कि aff.
जलधिगा: जलधिगा f. (-गा) A river. E. जलधि the sea, गा going.
जलधिजा: जलधिजा f. (-जा) A name of the goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. जलधि, and जा produced, the ocean-born; appearing at the churning of the ocean, amongst the fourteen precious things recovered from it.
जलनकुल: जलनकुल m. (-लः) An otter. E. जल, and नकुल an ichneumon; the water-ichneumon.
जलनिधि: जलनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. जल water, and निधि a nest.
जलनिर्गम: जलनिर्गम m. (-मः) A drain, a water-course, a pipe along a wall or building for carrying off water, a waterfall, the descent of a spring, &c. into a river below. E. जल water, निर्गम transit or passage.
जलनिवह: जलनिवह m. (-हः) A quantity of water. E. जल, and निवह a quantity.
जलनीली: जलनीली f. (-ली) Vallisneria. E. जल, and नीली a blue dye or indigo; imparting its own tinge to the stream.
जलन्धर: जलन्धर m. (-रः) An Asura sprung from ŚIVA, and adopted by the ocean. E. जलं, and धर who has.
जलपटल: जलपटल n. (-लं) 1 A quantity of water. 2 A cloud. E. जल, and पटल a quantity.
जलपति: जलपति m. (-तिः) 1 VARUṆA, the deity presiding over the watery element, the Hindu Neptune. 2 The ocean. E. जल, and पति lord or master.
जलपात्र: जलपात्र n. (-त्रं) A drinking vessel. E. जल, and पात्र vessel.
जलपान: जलपान n. (-नं) Drinking water: in Bengal, refreshment, luncheon. E. जल, and पान drinking.
जलपित्त: जलपित्त m. (-त्तः) Fire. E. जल, and पित्त bile; being as adust to water as bile is to the body.
जलपिप्पली: जलपिप्पली f. (-ली) An aquatic plant, (Commelina salicifolia, &c.) see जलभू. E. जल water, and पिप्पली long-pepper.
जलपृष्ठजा: जलपृष्ठजा f. (-जा) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. जल water, पृष्ठ back or surface, and ज produced.
जलप्राय: जलप्राय n. (-यं) A country abounding with water. E. जल, and प्राय abundance.
जलप्रिय: जलप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of water, frequenting water. m. (-यः) 1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 2 A fish. E. जल water, and प्रिय fond of.
जलप्लव: जलप्लव m. (-वः) An otter. E. जल water, and प्लव who goes or swims.
जलप्लावन: जलप्लावन n. (-नं) An inundation, a deluge. E. जल, and प्लावन overflowing.
जलबन्धक: जलबन्धक m. (-कः) A dam, a dike, rocks or stones impeding a current. E. जल water, and बन्धक confining.
जलबन्धु: जलबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fish. E. जल water, and बन्धु a friend.
जलबुद्वुद: जलबुद्वुद n. (-दं) A bubble of water. E. जल water, and बुद्वुद a bubble.
जलब्रह्मी: जलब्रह्मी f. (-ह्मी) A kind of potherb, (Hilancha repens.) E. जल, and ब्रह्मी an asclepias.
जलभू: जलभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Aquatic, produced in or by water. m. (-भूः) 1 A cloud. 2 An aquatic plant, (Commelina salicifolia or bengalensis:) see कञ्चट. E. जल water, and भू being or born.
जलमक्षिका: जलमक्षिका f. (-का) A water insect. E. जल, and मक्षिका a fly.
जलमद्गु: जलमद्गु m. (-द्गुः) A kingfisher. E. जल, and मद्गु another bird.
जलमसि: जलमसि m. (-सिः) A cloud. E. जल, and मसि ink; composed as it were of ink and water, alluding to its dark colour.
जलमार्ग: जलमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A drain or issue from a pond, &c. E. जल water, and मार्ग a road, a watercourse.
जलमार्जार: जलमार्जार m. (-रः) An otter. E. जल water, and मार्ज्जार a cat.
जलमुच्: जलमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. जल, and मुच् from मुच् to set free, affix क्विप्, liberating.
जलमूर्ति: जलमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) ŚIVA. E. जल, and मूर्त्ति form; of whom one form is water; implying his omnipresence.
जलमूर्त्ति: जलमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) ŚIVA. E. जल, and मूर्त्ति form; of whom one form is water; implying his omnipresence.
जलमूर्तिका: जलमूर्त्तिका f. (-का) Hail. E. जल, and मूर्त्ति form, with कन् added; a form or condition of water.
जलमूर्त्तिका: जलमूर्त्तिका f. (-का) Hail. E. जल, and मूर्त्ति form, with कन् added; a form or condition of water.
जलमोद: जलमोद n. (-दं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. जल, and मोद what delights.
जलयन्त्र: जलयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A waterwork, a machine for raising water, &c., any contrivance connected with that element. E. जल, and यन्त्र a machine.
जलयन्त्रगृह: जलयन्त्रगृह n. (-हं) A house or fabric erected in the midst of water, or subterraneous apartments constructed in the bank of a river, for retiring to in the hot season; a summer house, &c. E. जलयन्त्र a waterwork, and गृह a house; also similar compounds, as जलयत्त्रनिकेतन, जलयन्त्रमन्दिरं, &c.
जलरङ्क: जलरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. जल, and रङ्क miserly, greedy of water; feeding on small fish chiefly, and therefore haunting swamps, &c.
जलरङ्कु: जलरङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) A gallinule. E. जल, and रङ्कु a sort of deer; the water-deer.
जलरञ्ज: जलरञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) The Vaka, (Ardea nivea.) E. जल, रजि to be fond of, affix घञ्.
जलरण्ड: जलरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A whirlpool. 2 A drop or a thin sprinkling of water. 3 A snake. E. जल, and लडि to tremble, to play, &c. affix अच, and ल becomes र.
जलरस: जलरस n. (-सं) Salt. E. जल water, and रस taste, essence.
जलराशि: जलराशि f. (-शिः) A piece of water, a quantity of water. E. जल, and राशि a heap.
जलरुह्: जलरुह् m. (-रुट्) A lotus. E. जल water, रुह to mount, affix क्विप्; also with क affix, जलरुह n. (-हं.)
जलरूप: जलरूप m. (-पः) The fish of KĀMADEVA. E. जल, and रूप form.
जललता: जललता f. (-ता) A wave, a billow. E. जल water, and लता a creeping plant.
जलवरण्ट: जलवरण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A watery pustule, a sort of watery pox.
जलवल्कल: जलवल्कल n. (-लं) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. जल, and वल्कक bark, rind.
जलवायस: जलवायस m. (-सः) A bird, the diver. E. जल, and वायस a crow, the water-crow; also जलकाक.
जलवालक: जलवालक m. (-कः) The Vindhya mountain. E. जल water, वाड to dive, and ण्वुल् affix; ड changed to ल; alluding to the many streams that rise in this range.
जलवालिका: जलवालिका f. (-का) Lightning. E. जल water, and वालिका offspring, engendered at the rainy season.
जलवाह: जलवाह m. (-हः) 1 A cloud. 2 A water carrier. E. जल, and वह to bear, affix घञ्.
जलवाहन: जलवाहन n. (-नं) Flowing of water. f. (-नी) A watercourse, an aqueduct. E. जल, and वाहन bearing.
जलविडाल: जलविडाल m. (-लः) An otter. E. जल, and विडाल a cat; the water-cat.
जलविन्दु: जलविन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A drop of water. E. जल, and विन्दु a drop.
जलविल्व: जलविल्व m. (-ल्वः) 1 A crab. 2 A tortoise. 3 A piece of water. E. जल, and विल्व a particular tree and fruit.
जलविषुव: जलविषुव n. (-वं) The autumnal equinox, the moment of the sun's entering Libra. E. जल, and विषुव equinox; the watery equinox, occurring near the close of the annual rains.
जलवृश्चिक: जलवृश्चिक m. (-कः) A prawn or shrimp. E. जल water, वृश्चिक a scorpion.
जलव्यध: जलव्यध m. (-धः) A kind of fish, (Esox cancila, HAM.) E. जल, and व्यध to pierce, affix अच्.
जलव्याल: जलव्याल m. (-लः) 1 A water-snake. 2 A marine monster. E. जल, and व्याल a snake.
जलशय: जलशय m. (-यः) VIṢṆU. E. जल water, and शय who sleeps; he is supposed to sleep, borne by his serpent couch above the ocean, during the four months of the periodical rains in India; also during the intervals of the submersion of the world.
जलशयन: जलशयन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. जल water, शि to sleep, affix ल्यु, see the preceding.
जलशायिन्: जलशायिन् m. (-यी) VIṢṆU. E. जल, and शायिन् who sleeps: see the preceding.
जलशुक्ति: जलशुक्ति m. (-क्तिः) A bivalve shell. E. जल, and शुक्ति an oyster.
जलशुचि: जलशुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Bathed, washed. E. जल, and शुचि cleansing.
जलशूक: जलशूक m. (-कः) Vallisneria. E. जल, and शूक the beard of corn, &c.
जलशूकर: जलशूकर m. (-रः) A crocodile. E. जल, and शूकर a hog, the water-hog.
जलसंसर्ग: जलसंसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Mixture with water, dilution. E. जल, and संसग combination.
जलसर्पिणी: जलसर्पिणी f. (-णी) A leech. E. जल water, सृप to go or creep, affix णिनि and ङीष्.
जलसूचि: जलसूचि m. (-चिः) 1 A fish, a small sort of pike, (Esox cancila, HAM.) 2 The gangetic porpoise. 3 A heron. 4 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) f. (-चिः) A leech. E. जल water, and सूचि a needle.
जलस्थ: जलस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or abiding in water. E. जल, and स्थ who or what stays.
जलह: जलह n. (-हं) A small water (or summer) house. E. जल water, and हा to quit, affix डः see जलयन्त्रगृह, &c.
जलहास: जलहास m. (-सः) Cuttle fish bone, considered as the indurated foam of the sea; also जलहासक. E. जल water, and हास laugh, smile; alluding to its white colour.
जलाकर: जलाकर m. (-रः) A piece of water, a spring, a fountain. E. जल, and आकर a mine.
जलाका: जलाका f. (-का) A leech. E. जल, and अक to go, अच् aff.
जलाक्षी: जलाक्षी f. (-क्षी) An aquatic plant, (Commelina salicifolia.) E. जल, and अक्ष the eye, affix ङीष्: see जलपिप्पली.
जलाखु: जलाखु m. (-खुः) An otter. E. जल, and आखु a cat.
जलाञ्चल: जलाञ्चल n. (-लं) 1 A natural water-course or channel. 2 A plant, (Vallisneria.) E. जल, and अञ्चल end of a garment.
जलाञ्जलि: जलाञ्जलि f. (-लिः) A handful of water, or water held in the palms of the hand, as presented in oblation, &c. E. जल, and अञ्जलि salutation.
जलाटन: जलाटन m. (-नः) A heron. f. (-नी) A leech. E. जल water, अट to go, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.
जलाढ्य: जलाढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Watery, marshy. E. जल, and आद्य rich, abounding.
जलाण्टक: जलाण्टक m. (-कः) A shark, or according to some a large alligator, &c.: see ग्राह. E. जल water, अटि to go, क्वन् aff.
जलाण्डक: जलाण्डक m. (-कः) Small fry. E. जल water, अण्ड an egg, and कन् aff.
जलात्मिका: जलात्मिका f. (-का) 1 A leech. 2 A well. E. जल, and आत्मा being, existence, ठक् aff.
जलादर्श: जलादर्श m. (-र्शः) Water reflecting any object, a watery mirror. E. जल, and आदर्श a mirror.
जलाधार: जलाधार m. (-रः) A pond, a lake, a reservoir, any piece of water. E. जल, and आधार a receptacle.
जलाधिदैवत: जलाधिदैवत m. (-तः) A name of VARUṆA. n. (-तं) The asterism Pūrvāṣāḍhā. E. जल water, अधि over, and दैवत divinity; the possessor of divine supremacy over the element of water.
जलानुसार: जलानुसार m. (-रः) Going or acting like water. E. जल, and अनुसार agreeing with.
जलाभिषेक: जलाभिषेक m. (-कः) Sprinkling with water. E. जल, and अभिषेक aspersion.
जलाम्बिका: जलाम्बिका f. (-का) A well. E. जल, and अम्बिका a mother; bearing water as it were in its womb: the word is sometimes read जलात्मिका.
जलायुका: जलायुका f. (-का) A leech. E. जल water, अय to go, उकच् aff.
जलार्णव: जलार्णव m. (-वः) 1 The rainy season. 2 The sea of fresh water. E. जल water, and अर्णव a sea.
जलार्थिन्: जलार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिणी-र्थि) Thirsty, desirous of water. E. जल, and अर्थिन् desirous of.
जलार्द्र: जलार्द्र mfn. subst. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्रं) Wet cloth or clothes. adj. Wet, charged with aqueous moisture. E. जल water, and आर्द्र damp, moist.
जलालुका: जलालुका f. (-का) A leech. E. जल water, आलुच् affix, and कन् added; also जलायुका and जलालोका.
जलालोका: जलालोका f. (-का) A leech. E. जल water, आलोकृ to look or see, affix अच्.
जलावर्त: जलावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An eddy, a whirlpool. E. जल water, and आवर्त्त turning round.
जलावर्त्त: जलावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An eddy, a whirlpool. E. जल water, and आवर्त्त turning round.
जलाविल: जलाविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Stained or spotted with water. E. जल, and आविल muddy.
जलाशय: जलाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Stupid, dull, cold, apathetic. m. (-यः) 1 A pond, a tank, a lake, a reservoir or any piece of water. 2 The ocean. n. (-यं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. जल water, and आशय an abode or receptacle, or जल for जड cold, and आशय disposition.
जलाशायिन्: जलाशायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lying or sleeping in water as a penance. E. जल, and शी to sleep or lie, with आङ् prefixed, and णिनि aff.
जलाश्रय: जलाश्रय n. (-यं) 1 A piece of water, a pond, a lake. 2 A water-house. E. जल, and आश्रय refuge, abode.
जलाष्ठीला: जलाष्ठीला f. (-ला) A large square pond. E. जल water, स्था to abide, with आङ् prefixed, and अच् and ङीष् affixs. जलाष्ठी and लच् added.
जलाह्वय: जलाह्वय n. (-यं) A lotus. E. जल, and आह्वय appellation.
जलिका: जलिका f. (-का) A leech. E. जल water, and ठक् affix: see जलौका.
जलुका: जलुका f. (-का) A leech. E. जस to set free, (blood,) उक or ऊक Uṇādi affix, and स changed to ल; hence also, जलूका f. (-का) also जलौका, &c.
जलेचर: जलेचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Aquatic, living in or frequenting water. m. (-रः) 1 A fish. 2 Any kind of water fowl. E. जले in water, and चर who goes.
जलेजात: जलेजात n. (-तं) A lotus. E. जले the seventh case, in water, and जात born.
जलेन्द्र: जलेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 VARUṆA, the regent of water. 2 A Jina or Jaina saint. 3 The ocean of fresh water. E. जल water, and इन्द्र a ruler or chief.
जलेन्धन: जलेन्धन m. (-नः) Submarine fire. E. जल water, and इन्धन् inflaming.
जलेवाह: जलेवाह m. (-हः) A diver, (by caste or business.) E. जले, and वाह bearing.
जलेशय: जलेशय m. (-यः) A fish. E. जले in the seventh case, in water, and शय who sleeps or abides, from शीङ् to sleep, affix घ.
जलेश्वर: जलेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 A name of the deity of water, VARUṆA. 2 The ocean. E. जल, and ईश्वर sovereign.
जलोका: जलोका f. (-का) A leech. E. जल water, and ओक a house; also जलौका, जलौकस्.
जलोच्छ्वास: जलोच्छ्वास m. (-सः) A drain or channel, made on purpose for carrying off an excess of water, or such a channel made naturally by the overflow of a river, &c. E. जल water, उत् up, and श्वास breath, breathing forth or expiration.
जलोदर: जलोदर n. (-रं) Dropsy. E. जल, and उदर the belly.
जलोद्भव: जलोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Aquatic, marine, born of or in water. E. जल, and उद्भव produced.
जलोरगी: जलोरगी f. (-गी) A leech. E. जल water, उरग a snake, diminutive affix ङीष्.
जलौकस्: जलौकस् f. (-काः) A leech. E. जल, and ओकस् house; also जलौकस with a final vowel.
जलौकस: जलौकस mfn. sub. (-सः-सा-सं) A leech. E. as before: see जलौकस्, अच् being added.
जलौका: जलौका f. (-का) A leech. E. see the preceding; also जलोका.
जलौघ: जलौघ m. (-घः) A quantity of water. E. जल, and ओघ a heap.
जल्प: जल्प r. 1st cl. (जल्पति) 1 To speak articulately, to say or tell. 2 To prattle, to talk much or idly.
जल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 Dissention, wrangling. 2 Prate, babble. 3 (In Logic,) Refutation of an adversary's arguments, and assertion of one's own. E. जल्प to speak, affix अप्.
जल्पक: जल्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A chatterer, one who talks much or idly. E. जल्प to prate, ण्वुल् aff.
जल्पन: जल्पन n. (-नं) 1 Talking, saying. 2 Chattering, prattling. E. जल्प, and ल्युट् aff.
जल्पाक: जल्पाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A chatterer, talking much and foolishly, or improperly. E. जल्प to talk idly, षाकन् affix; also जल्पक.
जल्पित: जल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, told, spoken. n. (-तं) Talking, babbling, gossiping. E. जल्प to talk, affix क्त.
जव: जव (इ) जवि r. 10th. cl. (जंवयति) To shine.
जव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Swift, quick, expeditious. m. (-वः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 A runner, an express. f. (-वा) The China rose, (Hibiscus rosa sinensis;) also जपा. E. जु to move quickly, affix अच्.
जवन: जवन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) Quick, fleet. m. (-नः) 1 A courser, a fleet horse. 2 A country, Ionia or Greece: see यवन. 3 A native of that country. 4 A sort of deer. n. (-नं) Speed, velocity. f. (-नी) 1 A screen surrounding a tent, a Kenāt. 2 A drug. E. जु to be quick, affix ल्युट् or युच्, and fem. ङीष् or टाप्.
जवनाल: जवनाल n. (-लं) A sort of grain, (Andropogon bicolor:) see यवनाल.
जवनिका: जवनिका f. (-का) 1 A wall or screen of cloth surrounding a tent, an outer tent, &c. 2 A curtain, a screen in general. E. कन् added to जवनी.
जवस: जवस m. (-सः) Meadow or pasture grass. E. जु to grow quick, असच् affix: see यवस.
जवाधिक: जवाधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Very quick. m. (-कः) A fleet horse, a courser. E. जव speed, and अधिक exceeding.
जवानिल: जवानिल m. (-लः) A gale, a hurricane. E. जव fleet, अनिल wind.
जवापुष्प: जवापुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The China rose, the plant or its flower. E. जवा as above, and पुष्प a flower.
जविन्: जविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Quick or fleet, expeditious. m. (-वी) 1 A camel. 2 A horse. E. जव speed, इनि aff.
जष: जष r. 1st cl. (जषति) To kill, to wound, to hurt or injure.
जस: जस (इर उ) इर् जसु r. 4th cl. (जस्यति) To liberate, to set free, to let loose. r. 1st and 10th cls. (जसति जासयति) 1 To kill or injure. 2 To slight or disregard, to treat irreverently. 3 To strike, to punish with blows. (इ) जसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (जंसति जंसयति) To preserve, to protect.
जसुरि: जसुरि m. (-रिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. जस to kill or hurt, Uṇādi affix उरिन्.
जहक: जहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Abandoning, who leaves or abandons. m. (-कः) 1 Time. 2 A child. 3 The slough of a snake. E. हा to quit, or abandon, कन् Uṇādi aff.
जहत्: जहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Leaving, quitting, foregoing. E. हा to quit, शतृ aff.
जहत्स्वार्था: जहत्स्वार्था f. (-र्था) The use of a word in a sense different from its ordinary one. E. जहत्, and स्वार्थ own meaning.
जहा: जहा f. (-हा) A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī; also कदम्बपुष्पी, &c. E. हा to abandon ड, affixes and टाप्; shedding its leaves in spring.
जहानक: जहानक m. (-कः) The period of the total destruction of the world. E. हा to abandon, शानच् affix, and कन् added; also इ being substituted for the vowel of reduplication, जिहानक as it is sometimes read.
जह्नु: जह्नु m. (-ह्नुः) 1 The name of a king or saint, son of KURU: see the next. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. हा to abandon, (the world for devotion,) नु Uṇādi aff.
जह्नुतनया: जह्नुतनया f. (-या) The Ganges. E. जह्नु, and तनया the daughter; the river in its course disturbed the devotions of the saint JAHNU, upon which he drank up its waters; having released them at the intercession of BHAGĪRATHA, he is thus considered as the parent of the stream: see जाह्नवी; also जह्नुसुता, &c.
जागर: जागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Waking, awake. mf. (-रः-रा) Waking, wakefulness, vigilance, &c. m. (-रः) Mail, armour. E. जागृ to wake, affix अप्.
जागरण: जागरण n. (-णं) 1 Waking, watchfulness. 2 Keeping watch, sitting up at night as part of a religious ceremony. E. जागृ to be awake, affix ल्युट्.
जागरितृ: जागरितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wakeful, awake, vigilant. E. जागृ to wake, तृच् aff.
जागरिन्: जागरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wakeful, awake. E. जागृ to wake, णिनि aff.
जागरूक: जागरूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Wakeful, waking, watchful. E. जागृ to wake, ऊक aff.
जागर्ति: जागर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Waking, vigilance. 2 Keeping watch. E. जागृ to wake, क्तिच् aff.
जागर्त्ति: जागर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Waking, vigilance. 2 Keeping watch. E. जागृ to wake, क्तिच् aff.
जागर्या: जागर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Wakefulness, waking, watching. E. जागृ as above, यक् aff.
जागर्य्या: जागर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Wakefulness, waking, watching. E. जागृ as above, यक् aff.
जागृ: जागृ r. 2nd cl. (जागर्त्ति) To wake, to be awake or watchful.
जागृवि: जागृवि m. (-विः) Fire or its deity. E. जागृ to wake, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.
जाग्रत्: जाग्रत् mfn. (-ग्रन्-ग्रती-ग्रत्) Watching, being awake. E. जागृ to wake, Uṇādi affix शतृ.
जाग्रिया: जाग्रिया f. (-या) Waking, watching. E. जागृ to wake, यत् affix, ऋ changed to its congener रि.
जाङ्गल: जाङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 1 Rural, picturesque, diversified with hill, vale, wood, and water, (country.) 2 Wild, jaṅgala, barbarous, savage. 3 Wild, (not tame, as an animal, &c.) m. (-लः) The francoline partridge. f. (-ली) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) n. (-लं) 1 Flesh. 2 Game, the flesh of deer, &c. E. जङ्गल a wilderness, and अण् aff.
जाङ्गलि: जाङ्गलि m. (-लिः) A snake-catcher. E. जङ्गल a wilderness, and इञ् aff.
जाङ्गुल: जाङ्गुल n. (-लं) Poison, venom. f. (-ली) 1 Knowledge of poisons, the possession of charms or drugs, and employment of them as antidotes. 2 A potherb, (Luffa acutangula.) E. जङ्गुल poison, affix अण्.
जाङ्गुलि: जाङ्गुलि m. (-लिः) A snake-catcher, a dealer in antidotes. E. जङ्गुल, and इञ् aff.
जाङ्गुलिक: जाङ्गुलिक m. (-कः) A snake-catcher, a snake doctor, one who pretends, chiefly by charms, to cure the bite of snakes or other venomous animals, a dealer in antidotes, &c. E. जङ्गुल poison, and ठक् aff.
जाङ्घनी: जाङ्घनी f. (-नी) The thigh. E. जङ्घा the leg, affixes अण् and ङीष्, नुम् augment.
जाङ्घिक: जाङ्घिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the leg. m. (-कः) 1 A courier, a running footman, an express. 2 A camel. E. जङ्घा a leg, and ठक् aff.
जाजिन्: जाजिन् m. (-जी) A warrior, a combatant. E. जज to fight, and णिनि aff.
जाज्वल्यमान: जाज्वल्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, flaming, blazing. E. ज्वल to burn, intensitive form, शानच् aff.
जाटलि: जाटलि mf. (-लिः-ली) A plant, (Bignonia suave-olens;) a various reading for पाटलि, q. v.
जाड्य: जाड्य n. (-ड्यं) 1 Coldness, apathy. 2 Folly, stupidity, dulness or coldness of intellect. 3 Coldness, frigidity. E. जड cold, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
जात: जात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, engendered. 2 A child, offspring. 3 Apparent, manifest. 4 Produced, caused, occasioned. 5 Felt, entertained. 6 Inspired with, affected by. n. (-तं) 1 Kind, sort, class, species. 2 Multitude, collection. 3 Individuality, specific condition. 4 Birth, production. E. जन to be born, aff. क्त.
जातक: जातक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Born. m. (-कः) A mendicant. n. (-कं) Astrological calculation of a nativity. E. कन् added to the preceding.
जातकर्म्म: जातकर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) 1 A ceremony performed, when the navel string is divided, touching the infant's tongue thrice with ghee, with appropriate prayers, &c. 2 Delivery, &c. of a new-born infant. E. जात born, and कर्म्म rite.
जातदन्त: जातदन्त mf. (-न्तः-न्ती) A child that has got a tooth. E. जात, and दन्त a tooth.
जातप्रत्यय: जातप्रत्यय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confiding, believing, inspired with confidence. E. जात, and प्रत्यय trust.
जातमर्ष: जातमर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Enraged, vexed, angry. E. जात, and मष wrath.
जातमात्र: जातमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) What is just born, or merely born n. (-त्रं) As soon as born, the instant of birth. E. जात, and मात्रच् aff.
जातरूप: जातरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Embodied, assuming shape or form n. (-पं) Gold. E. जात produced, and रूप form.
जातवेदस्: जातवेदस् m. (-दाः) AGNI or fire. E. जात born, वेद a Veda, असि Uṇādi affix; or जात kind, sort, and विद to know, or comprehend, affix as before: one legend makes the Vedas to have issued from the mouth of AGNI.
जातश्रम: जातश्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wearied, exhausted. E. जात, and श्रम fatigue.
जातस्पृह: जातस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Desirous, wishing for. E. जात, and स्पृहा wish.
जातहार्द: जातहार्द्द mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दी-र्द्दं) Becoming attached to or fond of. E. जात, and हार्द्द affection.
जातहार्द्द: जातहार्द्द mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दी-र्द्दं) Becoming attached to or fond of. E. जात, and हार्द्द affection.
जातागस्: जातागस् mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः) Offending, sinning, committing any fault. E. जात, and आगस् sin; also जातापराध, जातदोष, &c.
जातापत्या: जातापत्या f. (-त्या) A mother, a woman who has borne a child. E. जात born, (by whom,) अपत्य offspring.
जाताश्रु: जाताश्रु mfn. (-श्रुः-श्रुः-श्रु) Weeping, shedding tears. E. जात, and अश्रु a tear.
जाति: जाति f. (-तिः) 1 Kind, sort, species, class, tribe. 2 Birth, production. 3 Lineage, race, family. 4 A fire place, a chimney. 5 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 6 A plant: see काम्पिल्ल. 7 A kind of poetical metre. 8 A rhetorical ornament. 9 (In Arithmetic,) Assimilation, as विशेषजाति assimilation of the difference, शेषजाति of the remainder. 10 Proximate cause or occurrence of disease, &c. f. (-तिः or -ती) 1 Great flowered jasmin, (J. grandiflorum.) 2 Mace, nutmeg. f. (-तिः) The flower of the jasmin. E. जन to be born, affix क्तिच्, and occasionally ङीष् added.
जातिकोश: जातिकोश n. (-शं) Nutmeg. E. जाति or जाती mace, and कोश or कोष sheathe; hence also जातिकोष, जातीकोश or जातीकोष.
जातित्व: जातित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Distinction or nature of caste or tribe. 2 Special or generic property. E. त्व added to जाति; also with तल्, जातिता.
जातिधर्म: जातिधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 The duty of caste, as sacred study of the Brahman, battle of the Kṣatriya, &c. 2 Generic or specific property. E. जाति, and धर्म्म duty.
जातिधर्म्म: जातिधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 The duty of caste, as sacred study of the Brahman, battle of the Kṣatriya, &c. 2 Generic or specific property. E. जाति, and धर्म्म duty.
जातिफल: जातिफल n. (-लं) Nutmeg. E. जाति or जाती mace, and फल fruit; also जातीफल; also जातिकोष, जाति or जाती, and जातिपुष्पं.
जातिभ्रंश: जातिभ्रंश m. (-शः) Loss of caste. E. जाति, and भ्रंश injury.
जातिभ्रंशकर: जातिभ्रंशकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Forbidden, improper, causing loss of caste. n. (-रं) Doing any act prohibited to a particular caste. E. जातिभ्रंश, and कर what makes.
जातिमात्र: जातिमात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Species, genus. 2 Caste only, not the performance of its especial duties. E. जाति, and मात्र only.
जातिलक्षण: जातिलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Specific or generic distinction or characteristic. 2 Mark of tribe or caste. E. जाति, and लक्षण indication.
जातिवैर: जातिवैर n. (-रं) Innate or instinctive hostility. E. जाति, and वैर enmity.
जातिवैलक्षण्य: जातिवैलक्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) Inconsistency, incompatibility, conduct or quality at variance with tribe or species. E. जाति, and वैलक्षण्य inconsistency.
जातिस्वभाव: जातिस्वभाव m. (-बः) Specific or generic character or nature. E. जाति, and स्वभाव nature.
जातिस्मर: जातिस्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One who recollects his condition in a former life. E. जाति, and स्मर who remembers.
जातिहीन: जातिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Outcaste, void of caste. E. जाति, and हीन void of.
जातीपत्री: जातीपत्री f. (-त्री) Mace. E. जाती, and पत्री a leaf.
जातीय: जातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to any species, belonging to any tribe or order, &c. E. जाति, and छ aff.
जातीरस: जातीरस n. (-सं) Gem myrrh. E. जाती nutmeg, and रस juice.
जातु: जातु ind. 1 Sometimes, occasionally. 2 A particle of prohibition. 3 Of doubt. 4 Of contempt or abuse. E. जै to waste or decay, तुन् aff.
जातुक: जातुक n. (-कं) Asafoetida. E. जतुक the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
जातुधान: जातुधान m. (-नः) A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin. E. जातु sometimes, धान possessing, from धा with ल्युट् or युच्; otherwise यातुधान.
जातुष: जातुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Made, &c. of lac, any artificial form or condition of it. E. जतु lac, अण् affix, and षुक् augment.
जातेष्टि: जातेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Rites performed at birth. E. जात, and इष्टि sacrifice.
जातोक्ष: जातोक्ष m. (-क्षः) A bullock. E. जात born, उक्ष an ox.
जात्य: जात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Well-born, legitimate, born of parents of the same caste. 2 Best, excellent. 3 Pleasing, beautiful. 4 Rectangular. E. जाति family, &c. यत् aff.
जात्यन्तर: जात्यन्तर n. (-रं) Interval of difference of caste. E. जाति, and अन्तर interval.
जात्यन्ध: जात्यन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Born blind. E. जाति birth, अन्ध blind.
जानकी: जानकी f. (-की) A name of SĪTĀ. E. जनक the father of this lady. affixes अण् and ङीष्.
जानत्: जानत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) Knowing, understanding. E. ज्ञा to know, शतृ aff.
जानन: जानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Knowing, understanding. E. ज्ञा to know, तङ् aff.
जानपद: जानपद m. (-दः) 1 Man, mankind. 2 An inhabited country. E. जनपद the same, and अण् aff.
जानु: जानु m. (-नुः) The knee. E. जन to be produced, (walking, motion,) ञुन् Uṇādi aff.
जानुफलक: जानुफलक n. (-कं) The knee pan or patella. E. जानु, and फलक a layer.
जानुसन्धि: जानुसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) The knee joint. E. जानु, and सन्धि articulation.
जाप: जाप m. (-पः) Muttering prayers or beads, reciting passages of the Vedas, &c. inaudibly. E. जप to mutter, &c. affix घञ्, deriv. irr.
जापक: जापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Muttering prayers, one who does so. E. जप, and ण्वुल् aff.
जापन: जापन n. (-नं) 1 Declining, rejection, dissent. 2 Dismissing, completing, finishing. E. जप to speak, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
जाप्य: जाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be muttered, &c. n. (-प्यं) The muttering of prayers, &c.
जाबाल: जाबाल m. (-लः) 1 A goatherd. 2 The name of a saint. E. अजा a goat, and पाल who cherishes, deriv. irr.
जाबालि: जाबालि m. (-लिः) The name of a Muni, one of the original teachers of the Vedas. E. जवल, and इञ् patronymic affix; also with अण्, जाबाल as before.
जामदग्न्य: जामदग्न्य m. (-ग्न्यः) A name of PARAŚURĀMA. E. जमदग्नि a Muni so named, and यञ् patronymick affix; the son of the saint JAMADAGNI.
जामातृ: जामातृ m. (-ता) 1 A daughter's husband, a son-in-law. 2 A husband, a lord or master. 3 A friend. 4 The sunflower, (Helianthus annuus.) E. जा for जाया a wife, मा to take, तृच् Uṇādi aff.
जामि: जामि f. (-मिः or मी) 1 A virtuous and respectable woman. 2 A sister, &c. E. जै to decline or decay, affix मि; or जम to eat, affix अण्, ङीप् optionally added.
जामेय: जामेय m. (-यः) A sister's son. E. जामि a sister, ढक् aff.
जाम्बव: जाम्बव n. (-वं) 1 The rose apple, the fruit. 2 Gold. E. जम्बु the tree, अण् aff.
जाम्बवौष्ठ: जाम्बवौष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A cauterising needle or probe.
जाम्बबत्: जाम्बबत् m. (-वान्) A fabulous bear, father-in-law to KṚṢṆA. E. जाम्ब the Jambu tree, and मतुप् affix; also जाम्बुवत्.
जाम्बूनद: जाम्बूनद n. (-दं) Gold. E. जम्बुनदी a river flowing from mount Sumeru, the Indian Pactolus, and अण् aff.
जाम्बूनदमय: जाम्बूनदमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden, made of gold. E. जाम्बूनद and मयट् aff.
जायक: जायक n. (-कं) A yellow fragrant wood. E. जि to excel (all perfumes), and ण्वुल् aff.
जायमान: जायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being born, coming into life. E. जन to be born, शानच् aff.
जाया: जाया f. (-या) A wife, one wedded according to the perfect ritual. E. जन to be born, affix यक्; in whom a man is again born, that is to say, he is re-born in his children.
जायाघ्न: जायाघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 A murderer of his wife. 2 A mole or mark on the body, indicative of the death of a wife. E. जाया, and घ्न what destroys.
जायाजीव: जायाजीव m. (-वः) An actor, a dancer. E. जाया a wife, and जीव who gets a livelihood.
जायात्व: जायात्व n. (-त्वं) The character or attributes of a wife. E. जाया, and त्व aff.
जायानुजीविन्: जायानुजीविन् m. (-वी) 1 An actor, a dancer, a mine, &c. 2 A kind of crane, the Vaka (Ardea nivea.) 3 A needy man, a pauper. 4 The husband of a harlot. E. जाया a wife, अनु like or with, and जीविन् who gets a livelihood; who is supported by his wife.
जायापती: जायापती m. du. (-ती) Husband and wife. E. जाया a wife, and पति husband.
जायु: जायु m. (-युः) A medicine, a medicament. E. जि to subdue, (disease,) Uṇādi affix उण्.
जार: जार m. (-रः) A paramour, a gallant. f. (-री) A drug, a medicament. E. जॄ to grow infirm, घञ् affix of agency, fem. ङीष्; weakening the affection of wives to their husbands, or diminishing the force of disease.
जारज: जारज mf. (-जः-जा) An adulterine, the child of a woman by her gallant. E. जार as above, and ज born.
जारजात: जारजात mf. (-तः-ता) An adulterine. E. जार, and जात born; also with कन् added, जारजातक.
जारण: जारण n. (-णं) 1 Calcining or oxydizing metals. 2 A condiment, a digester. E. जॄ to decay, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
जारभरा: जारभरा f. (-रा) An adulteress. E. जार, and भरा who cherishes.
जारुत्थ: जारुत्थ m. (-त्थः) A sacrifice, thrice worshipping the sun in his southern declination.
जाल: जाल n. (-लं) 1 A net. 2 A window, a lattice, an eyelet or loophole. 3 A multitude, an assemblage. 4 An unblown flower. 5 Pride, arrogance. 6 Magick, conjuring, illusion, super- natural deception. m. (-लः) 1 The Kadamba tree. 2 The young fruit of a gourd or cucumber. f. (-ली) 2 A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diœca, Rox.) 2 Any medicament or drug. E. जल to encompass, to hide or screen, affix अण्.
जालक: जालक n. (-कं) 1 A bud, a germ. An unblown flower. 3 A nest. 4 A net. 5 Pride. 6 A plantain, the fruit. 7 Multitude, assemblage. m. (-कः) A window, a lattice, a loop or eyelethole. f. (-लिका) 1 Armour, chain armour. 2 A kind of cloth or raiment, woollen cloth. 3 A leech. 4 A window. 5 Iron. E. जाल, and कन् added, or जल to enclose, वुन् aff.
जालकारक: जालकारक m. (-कः) 1 A spider. 2 A net-maker. E. जाल a net, cobweb, and कारक a fabricator.
जालकिनी: जालकिनी f. (-नी) A sheep, an ewe. E. जालक woollen cloth, इनि and ङीष् affis.
जालगर्दभ: जालगर्द्दभ m. (-भः) A dull spreading pimple or boil.
जालगर्द्दभ: जालगर्द्दभ m. (-भः) A dull spreading pimple or boil.
जालन्धर: जालन्धर m. (-रः) The name of a country situated in the northwest of India, apparently part of Lahore, and perhaps the modern Jallindhar. m. plu. (-रः) The inhabitants of Jālandhara.
जालपाद्: जालपाद् m. (-त् or द्) A goose. E. जाल a net, and पाद a foot; web-footed.
जालप्राया: जालप्राया f. (-या) Armour, iron network, or chain armour. E. जाल a net, and प्राय resembling.
जालबद्ध: जालबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Caught in a net, snared. E. जाल, and बद्ध bound.
जालिक: जालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A cheat, a rogue, a vagabond, a conjuror or juggler. 2 One who employs nets, &c. for a livelihood. m. (-कः) 1 A spider. 2 A fisherman. 3 A hunter using nets. E. जाल a net, &c. affix ठक्.
जालिन्: जालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Having a net. 2 Having a window. 3 Illusory, deceptive. m. (-ली) 1 A fisherman. 2 A hunter using nets. 3 A juggler. f. (-नी) A painting room. E. जाल a net, &c. इनि aff.
जाल्म: जाल्म mfn. (-ल्मः-ल्मा-ल्मं) 1 Cruel, harsh, severe. 2 Inconsiderate, rash, acting without thinking. m. (-ल्मः) A low man, one of a degraded tribe or business. E. जल to screen or hide, affix मक्.
जाषक: जाषक n. (-कं) A yellow fragrant wood. E. जष to hurt, affix ण्वुल्.
जाहक: जाहक m. (-कः) 1 A cat. 2 A pole-cat. 3 A bed, a cot. 4 A leech. E. हा to quit, affix ण्वुल्; radical initial doubled.
जाह्नवी: जाह्नवी f. (-वी) GAṄGĀ or the Ganges personified. E. जह्नु a saint, अण् affix of descent, fem. affix ङीष्, the daughter of JAHNU: see जह्नुतनया.
जि: जि r. 1st cl. (जयति) 1 To excel, to be pre-eminent, to surpass. 2 To conquer, to reduce or overcome. With वि or परा prefixed, (विजयते पराजयते) To overcome, to conquer.
जि mfn. (-जिः-जिः-जि) Victorious, conquering, a victor. m. (-जिः) A demon. E. जि to conquer, कि aff.
जिगत्नु: जिगत्नु m. (-त्नुः) Breath, life. E. गम to go, to depart, इत्नुच् Uṇādi affix, and the radical repeated.
जिगमिषत्: जिगमिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing or endeavouring to go. E. गम to go, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
जिगमिषा: जिगमिषा f. (-षा) Wish to go or move. E. गम to go, desider. form अङ्, and टाप् aff.
जिगमिषु: जिगमिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to go. E. गम to go, desiderative form, उ aff.
जिगरिषु: जिगरिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to take, to lay hold of, to take away. E. गृ to seize, desiderative form, उ aff.
जिगीषा: जिगीषा f. (-षा) 1 Emulation, wish to excel or overcome. 2 Eminence. 3 Usage, profession or habit of life. E. जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् aff.
जिगीषु: जिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Striving to overcome, vieing or contending with. E. जि to conquer; desiderative form, affix उ.
जिघत्सत्: जिघत्सत् mfn. (-त्सन्-त्सन्ती-त्सत्) Wishing to eat. E. अद to eat, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
जिघत्सा: जिघत्सा f. (-त्सा) Hunger. E. अद to eat, in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
जिघत्सु: जिघत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Hungry. E. see the preceding, affix उ.
जिघांसा: जिघांसा f. (-सा) Wish or intention to kill. E. हन to kill, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
जिघांसु: जिघांसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Mischievous, murderous, seeking to hurt or kill. m. (-सुः) An enemy. E. हन to kill, &c. in the desiderative form, उ aff.
जिघांसत्: जिघांसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Wishing to kill, murderous, felonious. E. हन to kill, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
जिघांसियस्: जिघांसियस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very desirous or determined to kill. E. जिघांस, and इयसुन् aff.
जिघृक्षत्: जिघृक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) Desirous to take, greedy, avaricious. E. ग्रह to take, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
जिघृक्षा: जिघृक्षा f. (-क्षा) Greediness, covetousness, wish to seize or take. E. ग्रह to take, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
जिघृक्षु: जिघृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to seize or take. E. ग्रह to take, desiderative form, उ aff.
जिघ्र: जिघ्र mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्रा-घ्रं) Smelling, who smells. E. घ्रा to smell, श affix, root reiterated.
जिघ्रत्: जिघ्रत् mfn. (-घ्रन्-घ्रती-घ्रत्) Smelling. E. घ्रा to smell, शतृ aff.
जिङ्गशल्य: जिङ्गशल्य m. (-ल्यः) A tree, (Mimosa catechu:) see जिह्मशल्य.
जिङ्घि: जिङ्घि f. (-ङ्घिः or ङ्घी) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith, Rox.) E. इङ्ग going, from इगि to go, &c. added to जि to excel, fem. affix ङीष्; excelling all other plants.
जिजीविषु: जिजीविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous of life. E. जीव to live, desiderative form, उ aff.
जिजीषत्: जिजीषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing or striving to overcome, emulous, ambitious, a warrior. E. जि to conquer, desiderative form, -शतृ aff.
जिज्ञापयिषु: जिज्ञापयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or seeking to inform. E. ज्ञः to know, desiderative form of the causal. उ aff.
जिज्ञासमान: जिज्ञासमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Inquiring, investigating. E. ज्ञा to know, desiderative form, शानच् aff.
जिज्ञासा: जिज्ञासा f. (-सा) 1 Asking, inquiring. 2 Search, investigation. E. ज्ञा to know, desider. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
जिज्ञासित: जिज्ञासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, inquired, sought. E. ज्ञा to know, desid. form, क्त aff.
जिज्ञासु: जिज्ञासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Inquiring, inquisitive. E. ज्ञा to know, desid. form, उ aff.
जित्: जित् mfn. (-जित्) Who or what conquers or surpasses. E. जि to conquer, affix क्विप्.
जित: जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, subdued, surpassed, overcome. m. (-तः) One of the attendants upon a Jina or Jaina saint. E. जि to conquer, aff. क्त.
जितकाशि: जितकाशि m. (-शिः) The fist doubled. E. जित conquered, काश to shine, इनि aff.
जितकाशिन्: जितकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Victorious. E. जित conquered, and काशिन् who shines, from काशृ, with णिनि aff.
जितक्रोध: जितक्रोध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of subdued passion, not to be provoked or made angry. E. जित, and क्रोध wrath.
जितनेमि: जितनेमि m. (-मिः) A staff made of the wood of the religious fig tree. E. जित excelled, (by which,) and नेमि circumference of a wheel, (of any other wood.)
जितशत्रु: जितशत्रु mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु) Victorious, triumphant. m. (-त्रुः) The father of AJITA, the 2nd Jaina saint. E. जित, and शत्रु a foe: see other similar compounds, as जितामित्र, जितारि, &c.
जितश्रम: जितश्रम m. (-मः) One who is free from worldly cares, a stoic. E. जित, and श्रम fatigue, exertion.
जिताक्षर: जिताक्षर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Reading well or readily. E. जित mastered, and अक्षर a letter.
जितात्मन्: जितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued, void of passion. E. जित, and आत्मन् spirit.
जितामित्र: जितामित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Triumphing, victorious over an enemy. m. (-त्रः) VIṢṆU. E. जित subdued, by whom, and अमित्र a foe.
जितारि: जितारि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Victorious, triumphant. m. (-रिः) 1 A Jina or Jaina deified saint. 2 The father of SAMBHAVA, the third of the Jaina pontiffs of this age. 3 A conqueror. E. जित conquered, (by whom,) and अरि an enemy.
जिताहव: जिताहव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Victorious, triumphant. E. जित conquered, and आहव war, battle.
जितेन्द्रिय: जितेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having subdued the senses, calm, unmoved. m. (-यः) An ascetic, a sage, one who has completely subdued his passions. E. जित subdued, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
जितेन्द्रियत्व: जितेन्द्रियत्व n. (-त्वं) Continence, subjugation of the senses or passions. E. त्व added to the last.
