जित्तम: जित्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Most victorious, first of the victors. m. (-मः) The constellation, Gemini. E. जित, and तमप् aff.
जित्य: जित्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Conquerable, vincible. m. (-त्यः) A harrow. f. (-त्या) A ploughshare. E. जि to excel, क्यप् affix, तुक् augment.
जित्वर: जित्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Victorious, triumphant. f. (-री) The city of Benares. E. जि to conquer or excel, क्वरप् affix, तुक् inserted, fem. affix ङीप्.
जित्वा: जित्वा ind. Having conquered or excelled. E. जि to conquer, क्त्वाच् aff.
जिन: जिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Victorious, triumphant. (-नः) 1 A Jina, the generic name of the personage peculiar to the Jaina sect, who is ranked by them as superior to the gods of the other sects: a saint and teacher: twenty-four Jinas are supposed to flourish in an Avasarpiṇī or Jaina age, and their writers enumerate those of the ages past, present, and to come. 2 A Buddha; a generic term applied to the chief saints of the Bauddha sect, in the same manner as to those of the Jainas. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. 4 A very old man. 5 A sage, one who is omniscient. E. जि to conquer or excel, नक् Uṇādi aff.
जिनयोनि: जिनयोनि m. (-निः) A deer. E. अजिन the skin of a deer, and योनि a place of production; the initial of the first word rejected; also अजिनयोनि.
जिनसद्मन्: जिनसद्मन् n. (-द्म) A Jaina temple. E. जिन a Jina, and सद्मन् abode.
जिनेन्द्र: जिनेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A Jaina or Jina saint. E. जिन a Jaina teacher, and इन्द्र a lord or master.
जिम: जिम (उ) जिमु r. 1st cl. (जेमते) To eat: see जम.
जिरि: जिरि r. 5th cl. but restricted to the Vedas (जिरिणोति) To injure, wound or kill.
जिव: जिव (इ) जिवि r. 1st cl. (जिम्वति) 1 To please, to delight or charm. 2 To be pleased or charmed. 3 To loose.
जिवाजिव: जिवाजिव m. (-वः) A pleasant: see जीवंजीव.
जिवि: जिवि r. 5th cl. (जिविनोति) To seek to hurt or kill.
जिव्रि: जिव्रि m. (-व्रिः) 1 Time. 2 A bird. E. जॄ to decay, Uṇādi affix क्रिन्, and व substituted for the conversion of ऋ.
जिष: जिष (उ) जिषु r. 1st cl. (जेषति) To sprinkle.
जिष्णु: जिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Victorious, triumphant. m. (-ष्णुः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 3 An epithet of INDRA. 2 A name of ARJUNA. E. जि to conquer, कस्रु aff.
जिहान: जिहान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Going, going to, attaining, obtaining. 2 Abandoning, leaving. E. हा to go, शानच् aff.
जिहानक: जिहानक m. (-कः) The destruction of the world: see जहानक.
जिहीर्षा: जिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish to take or seize. E. हृ to take, desiderative form, चङ् and टाप् aff.
जिहीर्षु: जिहीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing to take, seizing, carrying off. E. हृ to take, desiderative form, उ aff.
जिह्म: जिह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं) 1 Crooked. 2 Dishonest. 3 Slow, lazy. m. (-ह्मः) A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) E. हा to quit, (a straight line,) मन् Uṇādi affix, and the root reduplicated, deriv. irr.
जिह्मग: जिह्मग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going tortuously or lazily. m. (-गः) A snake. E. जिह्म as above, and ग what goes.
जिह्मता: जिह्मता f. (-ता) 1 Crookedness, curvature. 2 Dishonesty. E. तल added to जिह्म; also with त्व, जिह्मत्वं.
जिह्ममोहन: जिह्ममोहन m. (-नः) A frog. E. जिह्म slowly, and मोहन copulation.
जिह्मशल्य: जिह्मशल्य m. (-ल्यः) The Khadira, (Mimosa catechu.) E. जिह्म crooked, शल्य a dart.
जिह्मित: जिह्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, bowed, curved. 2 Turned away. E. जिह्म, and इतच् aff.
जिह्व: जिह्व mf. (-हूः-ह्वा) The tongue. E. लिह to lick, Uṇādi affix वन्, and the initial changed to ज.
जिह्वल: जिह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Greedy. E. जिहू the tongue, ल to take, क affix, deriv. irr.
जिह्वाग्र: जिह्वाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The tip of the tongue. E. जिह्वा, and अग्र end.
जिह्वानिर्लेखन: जिह्वानिर्लेखन n. (-नं) 1 Scraping the tongue. 2 A tongue-scraper. E. जिह्वा, and निर्लेखन scraping.
जिह्वाप: जिह्वाप m. (-पः) 1 A dog. 2 A cat. 3 A tiger. 4 The hunting leopard. 5 A bear. E. जिह्वा the tongue, and प who drinks, who laps.
जिह्वामल: जिह्वामल n. (-लं) The fur of the tongue. E. जिह्वा, and मल dirt, excretion.
जिह्वामूल: जिह्वामूल n. (-लं) The root of the tongue. E. जिह्वा, and मूल a root.
जिह्वामूलीय: जिह्वामूलीय m. (-यः) A character substituted for the Visarga, as हरिन्काम्य, and with a like sound. E. जिह्वामूल, and छ aff.
जिह्वारद: जिह्वारद m. (-दः) A bird. E. जिह्वा, and रद a tooth; whose tooth, (i. e. beak,) is like a tongue.
जिह्वालिह्: जिह्वालिह् m. (-लिट्) A dog. E. जिह्वा, and लिह् who licks or laps, from लिह with क्विप् aff.
जिह्वास्वाद: जिह्वास्वाद m. (-दः) Licking, lapping. E. जिह्वा the tongue, and आस्वाद eating.
जिह्वाशत: जिह्वाशत n. (-तं) A hundred tongues. E. जिह्वा, and शत a century.
जिह्वोल्लेखन: जिह्वोल्लेखन n. (-नं) Scraping the tongue. f. (-नी) A tongue-scraper, made of a thin piece of wood of the Mimusops Kauki or other trees. E. जिह्वा, and उल्लेखन scraping; also in the second sense, with कन् added, जिह्वोल्लेखनिका.
जीन: जीन mf. (-नः-ना-नं) Old, aged. E. ज्या to become old, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
जीमूत: जीमूत m. (-तः) 1 A cloud. 2 A mountain. 3 A grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 4 A name of INDRA. 5 A nourisher, a sustainer. 6 A plant: see घोषक. 7 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. जि to excel or surpass, Uṇādi affix तन्, and मूट् augment, or जी for जीव life, and मूत who urines.
जीमूतकुट: जीमूतकुट m. (-टः) A small hill near a mountain. E. जीमूत a mountain, and कुट a house.
जीमूतवाहन: जीमूतवाहन m. (-नः) 1 INDRA. 2 The author of a celebrated work on inheritance. E. जीमूत a cloud, and वाहन vehicle.
जीमूतवाहिन्: जीमूतवाहिन् m. (-ही) Smoke. E. जीमूत a cloud, and वह to bear, affix णिनि.
जीर: जीर m. (-रः) 1 Cumin seed. 2 A sacrificial knife or sword, a scymitar. 3 A sort of panic seed: see अणु. E. जु to go, or grow quickly, रक् Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel changed.
जीरक: जीरक m. (-कः) Cumin seed. E. कन् added to the preceding.
जीर्ण: जीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Withered, decayed. 3 Digested. m. (-र्णः) 1 An old man. 2 Cumin seed. n. (-र्णं) Benjamin. E. जॄ to become old or decayed, affix क्त.
जीर्णज्वर: जीर्णज्वर m. (-रः) Fever of some continuance and diminished intensity. E. जीर्ण, and ज्वर fever.
जीर्णता: जीर्णता f. (-ता) 1 Old age. 2 Infirmity, decay. E. जीर्ण, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जीर्णत्वं.
जीर्णदारु: जीर्णदारु m. (-रुः) A potherb, (Convolvulus argentaceus.) E. जीर्ण, and दारु wood.
जीर्णपर्ण: जीर्णपर्ण्ण m. (-र्णः) The Kadamba: see कदम्बक. n. (-र्णं) A withered leaf. E. जीर्ण old, withered, and पर्ण a leaf.
जीर्णपर्ण्ण: जीर्णपर्ण्ण m. (-र्णः) The Kadamba: see कदम्बक. n. (-र्णं) A withered leaf. E. जीर्ण old, withered, and पर्ण a leaf.
जीर्णवज्र: जीर्णवज्र n. (-ज्रं) A gem, said to be a sort of diamond. E. जीर्ण decayed, वज्र diamond.
जीर्णवत्: जीर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Old, decayed. E. जॄ to grow old, क्तवतु aff.
जीर्णवस्त्र: जीर्णवस्त्र n. (-स्रं) Old, worn or tattered raiment. E. जीर्ण old, and वस्त्र cloth or clothes.
जीर्णवाटिका: जीर्णवाटिका f. (-का) A ruined mansion. E. जीर्ण, and वाटिका a house.
जीर्णव्रध्नक: जीर्णव्रध्नक m. (-कः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. जीर्ण old, and व्रध्न a root, affix कन्.
जीर्णि: जीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Old age, infirmity, decay. 2 Digestion. E. जॄ to become old, क्तिन् aff.
जीर्णोद्यान: जीर्णोद्यान n. (-नं) A neglected garden. E. जीर्ण, and उद्यान a garden.
जीर्णोद्धार: जीर्णोद्धार m. (-रः) Repairing, renewal, repairs. E. जीर्ण, and उद्धार lifting up.
जीर्णोद्धृत: जीर्णोद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Repaired, renewed. E. जीर्ण, and उद्धृत lifted up.
जीर्वि: जीर्वि m. (-र्विः) 1 An axe. 2 A cart. 3 The body. E. जॄ to decay, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.
जीव: जीव (ऋ) जीवृ r. 1st cl. (जीवति) To live. With आङ्, To use or enjoy, to get a living. With उप, To be dependant on for a living. With सं or प्र, To live agreeably.

जीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Life, existence. mf. (-वः-वा) 1 Livelihood, profession, specific occupation. 2 A tree: see जीवन्ती. m. (-वः) 1 The sentient soul, the emanation of the deity, which is incorporated with the animal body, and gives it life, motion, and sensation; hence also called जीवात्मन्; it is opposed to that abstract state of the soul परमात्मन् in which by meditating upon its own divine nature and origin, the spirit is set at liberty from human feelings and passions. 2 A name of VṚHASPATI. 3 A name of the prince KARṆA. f. (-वा) 1 A bow string. 2 The earth. 3 The tinkling of metallic ornaments. 4 Orris root. 5 (In Geometry,) The chord of an arc. E. जीव to live, affix घञ् or क, and fem. affix टाप्.
जीवक: जीवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A servant, a slave, one who gets a livelihood by service. 2 A snake-catcher, one whose business is catching snakes, curing their bites, &c. 3 An usurer, or one who lives by lending money at high interest. 4 A mendicant or one who lives by begging. 5 One whose life is prolonged by blessings. m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa:) see असन. 2 A medicinal plant, commonly called by the same name Jīvaka, and considered as one of the eight principal drugs, classed together under the name अष्टवर्ग. 3 An animal, any being endowed with life. E. जीव to live, affix ण्वुल् or वुन्.
जीवग्राह: जीवग्राह m. (-हः) A prisoner, one taken alive. E. जीव, and ग्राह capture.
जीवजीव: जीवजीव m. (-वः) A kind of bird, supposed to be a sort of pheasant: see जीवञ्जीव.
जीवञ्जीव: जीवञ्जीव m. (-बः) 1 A kind of bird, supposed to be a pheasant. 5 The Cakora or Greek partridge. 3 A kind of tree. E. जीव life, and जीव who lives, from जीव with खच् affix, long-lived.
जीवत्: जीवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Living, alive. E. जीव to live, शतृ aff.
जीवत्तोका: जीवत्तोका f. (-का) A woman whose children are living. E. जीवत् living, and तोक offspring.
जीवत्पति: जीवत्पति f. (-तिः) A wife whose husband is alive. E. जीवत् living, and पति a husband.
जीवत्पितृक: जीवत्पितृक m. (-कः) A son whose father is alive. E. जीवत्, and पितृ a father, कन् added.
जीवथ: जीवथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Virtuous, pious. 2 Long-lived. m. (-थः) Virtue, piety. 2 Life, existence. 3 A cloud. 4 A peacock. 5 A tortoise. E. जीव to live, अथ Uṇādi aff.
जीवद: जीवद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Life-giving, who or what gives life. m. (-दः) 1 A physician, a practitioner of medicine. 2 An enemy. E. जीव life, and द in the first sense, from दा to give, in the second, from दो to destroy, affix ड.
जीवधन: जीवधन n. (-नं) Living property, live-stock, wealth in flocks and herds. E. जीव alive, and धन wealth.
जीवन: जीवन m. (-नः) 1 A plant, commonly Jiuti, (Odina wodier.) 2 A son. 3 A living being, an animal. f. (-ना or गी) A plant, commonly Jiyati: see जीवन्ती. f. (-नी) Jasmin. n. (-नं) 1 Life, existence. 2 Livelihood, profession. 3 Water. 4 Butter of new or one day-old milk. 5 Marrow. E. जीव to live, affix ल्यु or ल्युट्.
जीवनक: जीवनक m. (-कः) Food, especially boiled rice. E. कन् added to the preceding.
जीवनविडम्बन: जीवनविडम्बन n. (-नं) Disappointment of all hopes, living in vain. E. जीवन, and विडम्वन frustrating.
जीवनयोनि: जीवनयोनि m. (-निः) Communication of vitality with body. E. जीवम, and योनि origin.
जीवनहेतु: जीवनहेतु m. (-तुः) End or object of life, the cause of living. E. जीवन, and हेतु cause.
जीवनाघात: जीवनाघात n. (-तं) Poison. E. जीवन life, and आघात destroying.
जीवनान्त: जीवनान्त m. (-न्तः) Death. E. जीवन, and अन्त end.
जीवनावास: जीवनावास m. (-सः) VARUṆA, regent of water. E. जीवन water, and आवास abode.
जीवनीय: जीवनीय n. (-यं) Water. f. (-या) Jiyati: see जीवन्ती. E. जीवन life, छ affix; being friendly or necessary to existence.
जीवनोपाय: जीवनोपाय m. (-यः) Livelihood, means of subsistence. E. जीवन and उपाय means.
जीवनौषध: जीवनौषध n. (-धं) A drug to revive the dead. E. जीवन living, and औषध a medicament.
जीवन्त: जीवन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Living, existent. m. (-न्तः) 1 Life, existence. 2 A medicament, a drug. f. (-न्ती) 1 The name of a tree, commonly Jiyati, (Celtis orientalis.) 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची. 3 The Śami or Sāen tree, (Mimosa albida.) 4 A parasite plant. 5 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula, Rox.) E. जीव to live, affix झच्; fem. affix ङीप्; also with कन् added जीवन्तिका, &c.
जीवन्तिक: जीवन्तिक m. (-कः) A fowler, a bird-catcher: see जीवान्तक. f. (-का) 1 A parasite plant, (Epidendron tesseloides,) and other species. 3 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 A kind of potherb. E. कन् added to the preceding.
जीवन्मुक्त: जीवन्मुक्त m. (-क्तः) A man purified by knowledge of BRAHMA, and exonerated whilst living from future birth, and all ritual ceremonies. E. जीवत्, and मुक्त freed.
जीवन्मुक्ति: जीवन्मुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Acquirement of spiritual knowledge, and consequent liberation from future birth, and ritual acts. E. जीवत्, and मुक्ति liberation.
जीवपुत्रक: जीवपुत्रक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, commonly Ingua. 2 A different plant bearing seeds which are used in rosaries, commonly Jiyaputa, (Nageia putranjiva.)
जीवबध: जीवबध m. (-धः) Destruction of living beings. E. जीव, and बध killing.
जीवमन्दिर: जीवमन्दिर m. (-रः) The body. E. जीव life, and मन्दिर mansion.
जीवभूत: जीवभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Alive, endowed with life. E. जीव, and भूत become.
जीवलोक: जीवलोक n. (-कं) 1 The world, the habitation of living beings. 2 Mankind. E. जीव, and लोक world.
जीवसाधन: जीवसाधन n. (-नं) Rice, grain. E. जीव, and साधन means.
जीवसाफल्य: जीवसाफल्य n. (-ल्यं) Realisation of all one's wishes. E. जीव, and साफल्य fruitfulness.
जीवसू: जीवसू f. (-सूः) The mother of living offspring. E. जीव living, and सू bringing forth.
जीवस्थान: जीवस्थान n. (-नं) A joint, an articulation. E. जीव life, and स्थान place.
जीवाजीवाधार: जीवाजीवाधार m. (-रः) The material and visible world. E. जीव animate, and अजीव inanimate, आधार a support.
जीवातु: जीवातु mn. (-तुः-तु) 1 A drug for reanimating the dead. 2 Boiled rice, food. 3 Life, existence. E. जीव life, आतु Uṇādi aff.
जीवात्मन्: जीवात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The vital principle or spirit; that spiritual essence which renders bodies susceptible of motion or sensation. E. जीव life, and आत्मन् soul or spirit.
जीवाधार: जीवाधार m. (-रः) The world. E. जीव an animal, and आधार support.
जीवान्तक: जीवान्तक m. (-कः) 1 A fowler, a bird-catcher. 2 A destroyer of life, a slayer, a murderer. E. जीव a living being, and अन्तक a destroyer; also sometimes written जीवन्तक.
जीवाश: जीवाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Hoping for life. f. (-शा) Hope of living. E. जीव, and आशा hope.
जीविका: जीविका f. (-का) 1 Livelihood, profession or occupation by which a subsistence is obtained. 2 A tree: see जीवन्ती. E. जीव to live, ण्वुल् and टाप् affixes: see जीवक.
जीविकापन्न: जीविकापन्न mf. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Having obtained subsistence. E. जीविका, and आपन्न obtained.
जीविकाप्राप्त: जीविकाप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Having obtained as a livelihood. E. जीविका, and प्राप्त obtained.
जीवित: जीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Living, alive, existent. n. (-तं) Living, life, existence. E. जीव, and क्त aff.
जीवितकाल: जीवितकाल n. (-लं) Period or duration of life, a life. E. जीवित existence, and काल time.
जीवितज्ञा: जीवितज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) An artery, a vessel of the body. E. जीवित, and ज्ञा what knows.
जीवितव्य: जीवितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be lived, to be kept alive. E. जीव, and तव्य aff.
जीवितव्य m. (-यः) Casting away life. E. जीवित, and व्यय expense.
जीवितसंशय: जीवितसंशय m. (-यः) Fear of death. E. जीवित, and संशय doubt.
जीवितहारिन्: जीवितहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Destroying life. E. जीवित, and हारिन् what takes away.
जीविताशा: जीविताशा f. (-शा) Love of life. E. जीवित, and आशा hope.
जीवितेश: जीवितेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Ruling life, master of being, (applicable to objects either of reverence or affection.) m. (-शः) 1 A name of YAMA, regent of death. 2 The sun. 3 The moon. 4 A lover, a husband. 5 Lord or master of existence. 6 A drug to revive the dead. E. जीवित life, and ईश lord, ruler.
जीवोत्सर्ग: जीवोत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) Abandonment of life, voluntary death. E. जीव, and उत्सर्ग leaving.
जीविन्: जीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Alive, living, animate, a living being. E. जीव, and इनि aff.
जु: जु r. 1st cl. (जवति) 1 To go or move. 2 To move quickly, to go rapidly. (ङ) जुङ् r. 1st cl. (जवते) To go or move.
जुकुट: जुकुट m. (-टः) 1 The Malaya range of mountains. 2 A dog. n. (-टं) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
जुग: जुग (इ) जिगि r. 1st cl. (जुंगति) 1 To except, to exclude. 2 To quit or abandon.
जुगुप्सन: जुगुप्सन n. (-नं) Censure, abuse, reproach, reviling. E. गुप to censure, affix ल्युट्, or with अङ् and टाप् affixes जुगुप्सा; the root is always inflected in this sense, in the desiderative form.
जुगुप्सा: जुगुप्सा f. (-प्सा) Censure, &c. see the preceding.
जुगुप्सित: जुगुप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reviled, blamed, censured, abused. E. गुप to censure, affix क्त.
जुङ्ग: जुङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) E. जुगि to quit, affix घञ्, removing all blemishes; also with कन् added जुङ्गक m. (-कः).
जुङ्गित: जुङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Outcaste, deserted, injured, abandoned. m. (-तः) A man of a degraded caste, a Caṇḍāla, &c. E. जुगि to abandon, affix क्त.
जुटक: जुटक nf. (-टकं-टिका) 1 The matted hair of ŚIVA or of ascetics. 2 Any knot or fillet of hair. E. जट to collect, affix वुन्, and उ or ऊ inserted: see जटा; also जूट, जूटक, &c.
जुड: जुड r. 6th cl. (जुडति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To bind. 3 To join, as in making or mending. r. 10th cl. (जोडयति) 1 To send, to cast or throw, to direct. 2 To grind or pound.
जुत: जुत (ऋ) जुतृ r. 1st cl. (जोतते) To shine, &c.
जुन: जुन r. 6th cl. (जुनति) To go or move.
जुर्: जुर् f. (-जूः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Motion in general. E. ज्वर to make haste, affix क्विप्, and उठ् substituted for ब.
जुल: जुल r. 10th cl. (जोलयति) To reduce to powder.
जुर्व: जुर्व (इ) जुर्वी r. 1st cl. (जूर्वति) To hurt or kill.
जुष: जुष r. 1st and 10th cls. (जुषति जोषयति) 1 To reason, to think, to conceive or imagine, to investigate or examine. 2 To injure, to hurt or kill. 3 To like. (ञि ई) ञि जुषी r. 6th cl. (जुषते) To please, to gratify, to give satisfaction or delight, to serve.
जुष्कक: जुष्कक m. (-कः) The water of boiled pulse, pease soup, porridge, &c. E. जुष to please or satisfy, क affix, and deriv. irr. see जूष.
जुष्ट: जुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Served, obliged, worshipped, gratified by service. n. (-ष्टं) The crumbs or remnants of a meal or its leavings. E. जुष to please, &c. affix क्त.
जुष्य: जुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be served or worshipped. E. जुष to please, यत् aff.
जुहुवत्: जुहुवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sacrificing, offering oblations. m. (-वान्) Fire. E. हु to sacrifice, क्तवतु aff.
जुहुवान: जुहुवान m. (-नः) 1 Fire. 2 A tree. 3 A hard hearted man.
जुहू: जुहू f. (-हूः) A wooden vessel, of the shape of a semicircle or crescent, used at sacrifices. E. हु to sacrifice, Uṇādi affix क्विप्, the root reiterated, and the final made long; also remaining short जुहु. f. (-हुः.)
जुहूवत्: जुहूवत् m. (-वान्) Fire, or the deity AGNI. E. जुह्व a sacrificial vessel, and मतुप् possessing; being the medium of (burnt) offerings; also जुहुवत्.
जुहूराण: जुहूराण m. (-णः) 1 The moon. 2 Fire or its deity. 3 An officiating priest. E. हूर्च्छ to be crooked, to abandon, &c. Uṇādi affix आनच्; the root is reiterated, and the final छ rejected.
जुह्वत्: जुह्वत् mfn. (-ह्वन्-ह्वती-ह्वत्) Sacrifice, offering oblations. E. हु to sacrifice, शतृ aff.
जू: जू f. (-जूः) 1 Æther, heaven. 2 A name of the goddess SARASVATĪ. 3 A female demon or goblin. 4 Speed, expedition, velocity. 5 Going, motion. E. जु to go swiftly, affix क्विप्, and the final lengthened.
जूट: जूट m. (-टः) 1 The matted hair of ŚIVA. 2 The clotted hair of an ascetic. E. जट to collect, affix अच्, ऊ inserted: see जटा; also with कन् added जूटक. n. (-कं) And with a short vowel जुटक q. v; it is also used compounded with जटा in the same sense, as जटाजूट.
जूति: जूति f. (-तिः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Going, proceeding, moving. E. जु to go swiftly, affix क्तिन्, deriv. irr.
जूर: जूर (ई) जूरी r. 4th cl. (जूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt, to injure, to world or kill. 2 To be decayed, to decay or grow old.
जूर्णाह्वय: जूर्णाह्वय m. (-यः) A kind of grain, (Andropogon sorghum:) see देवधान्य.
जूर्णि: जूर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Speed. 2 The body. 3 The sun. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 Fever. E. ज्वर to be feverish, Uṇādi affix नि.
जूर्ति: जूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Fever, feverish or morbid heat. E. ज्वर to be feverish, क्तिन् aff.
जूर्त्ति: जूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Fever, feverish or morbid heat. E. ज्वर to be feverish, क्तिन् aff.
जूर्व्व: जूर्व्व (-ई) जूर्व्वी (जूर्व्वति) To hurt or kill.
जूष: जूष r. 1st cl. (जूषति-ते) To kill or hurt.
जूष n. (-षं) The water of boiled pulse, pease soup, porridge, &c. E. जुष to satisfy, affix क, and the radical vowel made long.
जूषण: जूषण n. (-णं) A plant, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. जष to hurt, affix ल्युट्.
जृ: जृ r. 1st cl. (जरति) To make short or low.
जृभ: जृभ (ई) जृभी r. 1st cl. (जर्भते) or more commonly r. 1st cl. (इ) जृभि (जृम्भते) To gape, to yawn. r. 10th cl. (जृम्भयति) To fear, to dread.
जृम्भ: जृम्भ mfn. sub. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Gaping, yawning. 2 Expansion, stretching, expanding. 3 Swelling, a puffing or blowing up. 4 Blowing blossoming. E. जृभि to gape, affix घञ्.
जृम्भक: जृम्भक m. (-कः) A subordinate deity. 2 A yawner. E. जृभि, and वुन् aff.
जृम्भण: जृम्भण n. (-णं) 1 Gaping, yawning. 2 Blowing. E. जृभि to yawn, affix ल्युट्.
जृम्भमाण: जृम्भमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Yawning, gaping. 2 Opening, blowing. E. जृभि to open, शानच् aff.
जृम्भावत्: जृम्भावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Yawning, gaping. E. जृम्भा, and मतुप् aff.
जृम्भिका: जृम्भिका f. (-का) Gaping, yawning. E. जृम्भि, and क्वुन् affix, fem. form.
जृम्भित: जृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opened, expanded. 2 Enlarged. 3 Done, exerted. 4 Opened, (as a flower,) blown. n. (-तं) 1 Gaping, yawning. 2 Swelling, expansion. 3 Bursting, opening. 4 Wish, active wish or search for. E. जृभि to gape, affix क्त.
जृम्भिन्: जृम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Who or what yawns or gapes. 2 Expanding, blossoming. f. (-नी) A kind of Mimosa, (M. octandra.) E. जृम्भ bursting, budding, and इनि aff.
जॄ: जॄ r. 1st cl. (जरति) 4th cl. (जोर्य्यते) 9th cl. (जृणाति) and 10th cl. (जारयति) To grow old, to be or become old or decayed.
जेतव्य: जेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be conquered or overcome, to be surpassed or excelled. E. जि to conquer, तव्य aff.
जेतृ: जेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Victorious, triumphant. 2 Surpassing, excelling. m. (-ता) A victor, a conqueror. E. जि to conquer, तृच् aff.
जेन्ताक: जेन्ताक m. (-कः) A dry hot bath, or heated chamber for inducing perspiration in rheumatism, &c.
जेमन: जेमन n. (-नं) 1 Food, victuals. 2 Eating. E. जमु to eat, affix ल्युट्.
जेय: जेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Conquerable, fit or subject to be conquered. E. जि to conquer, affix यत्.
जेष: जेष (ऋ) जेषृ r. 1st cl. (जेषते) To go or move.
जेह: जेह (ऋ) जेहृ r. 1st cl. (जेहते) To resolve, to attempt resolutely, to endeavour diligently or perseveringly. 2 To go, to move.
जै: जै r. 1st cl. (जायति) To wane or decline.
जैत्र: जैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Victorious, triumphant. m. (-त्रः) A conqueror, a victor. f. (-त्री) A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.) E. जि to conquer or excel, ष्ट्रन् aff.
जैत्ररथ: जैत्ररथ m. (-थः) A hero, a victor, a conqueror. E. जैत्र victorious, and रथ a car; whose chariot is triumphant.
जैन: जैन m. (-नः) A Jaina, a follower of the principles of a Jina or teacher of heterodox notions, the chief of which are, the supremacy of certain religious pontiffs over the gods of the Hindus, a denial of the divine authority of the Vedas, and a disregard of the distinction of castes. E. जिन a Jina, and अण् aff.
जैपाल: जैपाल m. (-लः) A plant, (Croton tiglium:) see जयपाल, the diphthong being considered as a substitute for the semivowel and vowels of the first members of the compound; it is most probably a corruption borrowed from the dialects in which such a substitution is common.
जैमिनि: जैमिनि m. (-निः) The name of a celebrated saint and philosopher, the pupil of VYĀSA, and founder of the Uttara Mīmāṃsā school.
जैवातृक: जैवातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Long-lived. 2 Thin, spare. m. (-कः) 1 The moon. 2 A drug, a medicament. 3 Camphor. 4 A son. E. जीव life, आतृकन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel changed.
जैष्णव: जैष्णव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to a conqueror, to ARJUNA, &c. E. जिष्णु as above, and अण् aff.
जैह्म्य: जैह्म्य n. (-ह्म्यं) Crookedness, moral or physical. E. जिह्म crooked, ष्यञ् aff.
जोङ्गक: जोङ्गक n. (-कं) Aloe wood or Agallochum. E. जुगि to remove, ण्वुल् affix; dissipating bad smells.
जोङ्गट: जोङ्गट m. (-टः) Longing for, wishing earnestly or eagerly. E. जुगि to abandon, (all objects save that desired,) and अटन् aff.
जोटिङ्ग: जोटिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A devotee, an ascetic, who subjects himself to the severest penances. E. जूट the braided hair of ŚIVA, ग who goes, from गम to go, the form is irregular.
जोन्ताला: जोन्ताला f. (-ला) A kind of grain: see देवधान्य.
जोष: जोष n. (-षं) Happiness, felicity, pleasure, enjoyment, satisfaction. f. (-षा) A woman: see योषा; also जोषित्, जोषिता, &c. E. जुष to delight, affix घञ्, fem. affix टाप्.
जोषम्: जोषम् ind. 1 Silently. 2 In happiness, delightedly at ease, &c. 3 Well, excellently. 4 Excessively, beyond bounds. E. जुष to please or be pleased, affix अम्.
जोषिका: जोषिका f. (-का) A bud, a germ. E. जुष to please, affix वुन्, and fem. form; some copies have more accurately perhaps कोषिका.
जोषित्: जोषित् f. (-षित्) A woman. E. जुष to delight, affix इति; also योषित्, जोषिता, &c.
जोषिता: जोषिता f. (-ता) A woman. E. जुष to please, affix क्त; also योषित, योषिता, &c.
ज्ञ: ज्ञ A compound letter, considered to be composed of ज and ज्ञ; it is usually expressed by jn or gn, but its peculiar nasal sound is not well conveyed by any combination of the Roman alphabet.

ज्ञ mfn. (ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Who or what knows. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A wise and learned man; it especially applies to one possessed of sacred learning, and religious knowledge. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 The moon. 4 Buddha, first of the line of the moon, and regent of the planet MERCURY. 5 The planet MARS or its regent. E. ज्ञा to know, to possess knowledge, affix क.
ज्ञप: ज्ञप r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयति) 1 To know. 2 To cause to be known: see ज्ञा. 3 To whet or sharpen. 4 To beat. 5 To please.
ज्ञपित: ज्ञपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught, expounded, made known. E. ज्ञप to make known, affix क्त, इट् optionally inserted, otherwise ज्ञप्त.
ज्ञप्त: ज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Made known: see the preceding.
ज्ञप्ति: ज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Understanding, comprehension, the exercise of the intellectual faculty. E. ज्ञप to make known, affix क्तिन्, deriv. irr.
ज्ञा: ज्ञा r. 9th cl. (जानाति जानीते) To know, to understand. With अनु prefixed, 1 To assent or conform to. 2 To acknowledge. With अप, To conceal. With अव, To disrespect, to despise. With उप, To deny knowledge of any thing. With परि, To ascertain. With प्र, To know well. With प्रति or सम्, To assent, to admit, to agree, to promise. With प्रति and अभि, To recognise. With वि, To discriminate, to know. With सम्, To recollect or possess the power of knowing. (In combination, it usually takes the deponent form, as अनुजानीते, अपजानीते, &c.) r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयति) To command, to direct; आङ् is usually prefixed in this sense. r. 1st cl. but occurring in the form of the causal, (ज्ञपयति) 1 To slay. 2 To gratify or please. 3 To exhibit. 4 To sharpen. 5 To praise. In these senses the root is, in general, combined with a prefix.
ज्ञात: ज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, comprehended, understood fully. E. ज्ञा to know, affix क्त.
ज्ञातव्य: ज्ञातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be known or understood. E. ज्ञा, and तव्य aff.
ज्ञातसिद्धान्त: ज्ञातसिद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) A man completely versed in any science or Śāstra. E. ज्ञात what is known, and सिद्धान्त completion.
ज्ञातान्वय: ज्ञातान्वय m. (-यः) A name of Varddhamāna, the last Jina or Jaina pontiff. E. ज्ञात known, and अन्वय lineage.
ज्ञाति: ज्ञाति m. (-तिः) 1 A father. 2 A kinsman in general. 3 A distant kinsman, one who does not participate in the oblations of food or water offered to deceased ancestors. E. ज्ञा to know, affix क्तिन्; who is known, an acquaintance.
ज्ञातिकर्मन्: ज्ञातिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Duty of kindred. E. ज्ञाति, and कम्म act; also ज्ञातिकार्य्य.
ज्ञातिकर्म्मन्: ज्ञातिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Duty of kindred. E. ज्ञाति, and कम्म act; also ज्ञातिकार्य्य.
ज्ञातित्व: ज्ञातित्व n. (-त्वं) Relationship, kin. E. त्व added to ज्ञाति.
ज्ञातृ: ज्ञातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Knowing, wise, intelligent, who or what knows. E. ज्ञा to know, तृच् active aff.
ज्ञातेय: ज्ञातेय n. (-यं) Relationship, affinity. E. ज्ञाति a kinsman, and ढक् aff.
ज्ञात्वा: ज्ञात्वा ind. Having known. E. ज्ञा to know, क्त्वाच् aff.
ज्ञान: ज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Knowledge in general. 2 Knowledge of a specific and religious kind, that which is derived from meditation, and the study of philosophy, which teaches man the divine nature and origin of his immaterial part, with the unreality of corporal enjoyments or worldly forms, and which, separating him during life from terrestrial objects, secures him, after death, a final emancipation from existence, and reunion with the universal spirit. E. ज्ञा to know, aff. ल्युट्.
ज्ञानगम्य: ज्ञानगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Attainable by knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and गम्य attainable.
ज्ञानचक्षुस्: ज्ञानचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Intellect, intellectual vision. E. ज्ञान, and चक्षुस् the eye.
ज्ञानतपस्: ज्ञानतपस् n. (-पः) Cultivation of sacred knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and तपस् religious austerity.
ज्ञानतस्: ज्ञानतस् ind. By or through knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and तसिल् aff.
ज्ञानदर्पण: ज्ञानदर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Jaina saints. E. ज्ञान true knowledge, and दर्पण a mirror.
ज्ञानदीप: ज्ञानदीप m. (-पः) Knowledge, the lamp of knowledge. E. ज्ञान, दीप a lamp.
ज्ञाननिष्ठ: ज्ञाननिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Cultivating spiritual knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and निष्ठ engaged in.
ज्ञानपर: ज्ञानपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Versed in spiritual wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and पर attentive to.
ज्ञानपूर्व: ज्ञानपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Preceded by the acquirement of divine wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and पूर्व्व prior.
ज्ञानपूर्व्व: ज्ञानपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Preceded by the acquirement of divine wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and पूर्व्व prior.
ज्ञानमय: ज्ञानमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting of knowledge, made up of it. E. ज्ञान, and मयट् aff.
ज्ञानमुद्र: ज्ञानमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Having the impress of wisdom, wise, making wise. E. ज्ञान, and मुद्रा a seal.
ज्ञानमूल: ज्ञानमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Founded on spiritual knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and मूल root.
ज्ञानलक्षण: ज्ञानलक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Indication, sign, means of knowing or inferring. 2 (In Logic,) Sign or proof of knowledge, or subsequent derived from antecedent knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and लक्षण indication.
ज्ञानवत्: ज्ञानवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wise, especially in spiritual things. E. ज्ञान, and मतुप् aff.
ज्ञानविज्ञान: ज्ञानविज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Sacred and profane knowledge. 2 The Vedas and their subordinate parts, as medicine, war, &c. E. ज्ञान, and विज्ञान miscellaneous knowledge.
ज्ञानानुत्पाद: ज्ञानानुत्पाद m. (-दः) Folly, ignorance. E. ज्ञान, and अनुत्पाद nonproduction.
ज्ञानावस्थित: ज्ञानावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Occupied by wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and अवस्थित placed.
ज्ञानिन्: ज्ञानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) 1 Wise, intelligent. 2 Knowing, who or what knows. m. (-नी) 1 An astrologer, a fortuneteller, a man prescient of future events. 2 A sage, one possessing religious wisdom or Jñāna (ज्ञान) as above. E. ज्ञान knowledge, affix इनि.
ज्ञानेन्द्रिय: ज्ञानेन्द्रिय m. (-यं) An organ of perception or consciousness, the skin, tongue, eye, ear and intellect. E. ज्ञान, and इन्द्रिय an organ.
ज्ञापक: ज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Making or causing to know. m. (-कः) An instructor. 2 A commander, a master. E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, वुन् aff.
ज्ञापन: ज्ञापन n. (-नं) Making known, apprising, informing. E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
ज्ञाप्ति: ज्ञाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Making known, informing. E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, क्तिन् aff.
ज्ञेय: ज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be known, what may be or ought to be known. E. ज्ञा, and यत् aff.
ज्यका: ज्यका f. (-का) The chord of an arc. E. ज्या the same, कन् added.
ज्या: ज्या r. 9th cl. (जिनाति) To decay, to be or become old.
ज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 A mother. 2 The earth. 3 A bowstring. 4 The chord of an arc. E. ज्या to become old, to decay, affixes अङ्, and टाप्.
ज्याघोष: ज्याघोष m. (-षः) Twang of a bow. E. ज्या, and घोष sound.
ज्यानि: ज्यानि f. (-निः) 1 Old age, decay, infirmity. 2 Abandoning, quitting, leaving. 3 A river, a stream. E. ज्या to decay, &c. Uṇādi aff. नि.
ज्यायस्: ज्यायस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very old. 2 Very excellent, best. 3 Elder, elder born. 4 In law, one independent and answerable for his own conduct. E. ज्या to be old, इयसुन् affix.
ज्यु: ज्यु r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते) To go or approach.
ज्युत: ज्युत r. 1st cl. (ऋ) ज्युतृ (ज्योतते;) also (इर) ज्युतिर r. 1st cl. (ज्योतति) To shine. see द्युत.
ज्येष्ठ: ज्येष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Best, most excellent, pre-eminent. 2 Very old, oldest. 3 Elder, elder born. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 One of the asterisms considered as lunar mansions; the eighteenth, comprising three stars, of which one is a Scorpionis, figured by a ring or earring. 2 The middle finger. 3 Misfortune, personified as a goddess. 4 The Ganges, (-ष्ठा or ष्ठी) A small house lizard. m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyaiṣṭha or Jeyte, (May-June.) n. (-ष्ठं) Age, oldness. E. ज्या to decay, to grow infirm or old, affix इष्ठन्, fem. affixes. टाप् and ङीष्.
ज्येष्ठता: ज्येष्ठता f. (-ता) 1 Seniority. 2 Superiority. E. ज्येष्ठ, and तल् affix; also ज्येष्ठत्वं.
ज्येष्ठतात: ज्येष्ठतात m. (-तः) A father's elder brother. E. ज्येष्ठ elder born, and तात a father; the usual order of composition is here irregularly inverted.
ज्येष्ठभार्या: ज्येष्ठभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) 1 An elder brother's wife. 2 The elder or chief wife. E. ज्येष्ठ, and भार्य्या a wife.
ज्येष्ठभार्य्या: ज्येष्ठभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) 1 An elder brother's wife. 2 The elder or chief wife. E. ज्येष्ठ, and भार्य्या a wife.
ज्येष्ठवर्ण: ज्येष्ठवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A Brahman. E. ज्येष्ठ elder born or best, and वर्ण tribe.
ज्येष्ठवृत्ति: ज्येष्ठवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The duties of age or seniority. E. ज्येष्ठ, and वृत्ति practice.
ज्येष्ठावाप्य: ज्येष्ठावाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be obtained by virtue or seniority, &c. E. ज्येष्ठ, and आवाप्य obtainable.
ज्येष्ठश्वश्रू: ज्येष्ठश्वश्रू f. (-श्रूः) A wife's elder sister. E. ज्येष्ठ elder, श्वश्रू motherin-law.
ज्येष्ठसामन्: ज्येष्ठसामन् n. (-म) 1 A portion of the Sāma Veda. 2 A religious rite of which its perusal is a part.
ज्येष्ठांश: ज्येष्ठांश m. (-शः) 1 The elder brother's share. 2 The best share. E. ज्येष्ठ, and अंश a share.
ज्येष्ठामूलीय: ज्येष्ठामूलीय m. (-यः) The month Jyeṣṭha. E. ज्येष्ठा the constellation, (as above,) मूल root, origin, and छ aff.
ज्येष्ठाम्बु: ज्येष्ठाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The scum of boiled rice, or water in which grain has been washed. E. ज्येष्ठ, and अम्बु water.
ज्येष्ठाश्रम: ज्येष्ठाश्रम m. (-मः) 1 The order of the householder. 2 A householder. E. ज्येष्ठ, and आश्रम order.
ज्येष्ठाश्रमिन्: ज्येष्ठाश्रमिन् m. (-मी) A householder, a man of the second order. E. ज्येष्ठ best, आश्रम order, इनि aff.
ज्यैष्ठ: ज्यैष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyaiṣṭha or Jyeṣṭha or Jeyte, (MayJune.) f. (-ष्ठी) 1 The day of full moon in Jyeṣṭha. 2 A house lizard. E. ज्यैष्ठा the mansion or asterism which the moon is in this month, and अण् aff.
ज्यैष्ठसामन्: ज्यैष्ठसामन् m. (-मा) A Brahman versed in that portion of the Sāma Veda called Jyeṣṭha Sāma. E. ज्येष्ठसामन् as above, aff. अण्.
ज्यैष्ठिनेय: ज्यैष्ठिनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Born of the elder or principal wife. E. ज्यैष्ठा, and ढक् affix, इनङ् inserted.
ज्यैष्ठ्य: ज्यैष्ठ्य n. (-ष्ठ्यं) Seniority, age. E. ज्यैष्ट, and यञ् aff.
ज्यो: ज्यो r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते) 1 To advise or instruct. 2 To order. 3 To observe a vow or any religious obligation.
ज्योतिःशास्त्र: ज्योतिःशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The science of Astronomy. E. ज्योतिस्, and शास्त्र a scripture.
ज्योतिरिङ्ग: ज्योतिरिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A fire fly. E. ज्योतिस् light, इगि to go, affix क; also with युच् affix, ज्योतिरिङ्गण n. (-णं).
ज्योतिर्गण: ज्योतिर्गण m. (-णः) The heavenly bodies collectively. E. ज्योतिम् a planet, and गण a class.
ज्योतिर्विद्: ज्योतिर्विद् m. (-त्) An astrologer, an arithmetician. E. ज्योतिस्, and विद् who knows.
ज्योतिर्विद्या: ज्योतिर्विद्या f. (-द्या) The science of computation, from arithmetic to astronomy and astrology. E. ज्योतिस्, and विद्या science.
ज्योतिर्वीज: ज्योतिर्वीज n. (-जं) A fire fly. E. ज्योतिस् light, and वीज seed.
ज्योतिश्चक्र: ज्योतिश्चक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 The zodiac. 2 The lunar mansion. E. ज्योतिस् planet, and चक्र a sphere.
ज्योतिष: ज्योतिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Astrological, astronomical, relating to the heavenly bodies. mf. (-षः-षी) An astrologer. n. (-षं) Mathematical, astronomical, and astrological science, astronomy, astrology. f. (-षी) A star, a planet, an asterism. E. ज्योतिस् light, especially of the heavenly bodies, affix अण्, fem. ङीष्
ज्योतिषिक: ज्योतिषिक m. (-कः) An astrologer: see ज्यौतिषिक.
ज्योतिष्क: ज्योतिष्क m. (-ष्कः) 1 A planetary or heavenly body; the generic term for the sun, the moon, a planet, an asterism, a star: the word in the m. plu. (-ष्काः) implies all these five. 2 A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition: see गणिकारिका. f. (-का) Heart-pea: see ज्योतिष्मती. E. ज्योतिस् light, and क what makes, from कृ, with ड aff.
ज्योतिष्कल्प: ज्योतिष्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Blazing, radiant, like flame or fire. E. ज्योतिस्, and कल्प affix, implying resemblance.
ज्योतिष्टोम: ज्योतिष्टोम n. (-मं) A particular sacrifice at which sixteen officiating priests are required. E. ज्योतिस् light, and स्तोम a sacrifice.
ज्योतिष्मत्: ज्योतिष्मत् m. (-मान्) The sun. f. (-मती) Heart-pea, (Halicacabum cardiospermum.) E. ज्योतिस् light or splendor, and मतुप् poss. aff.
ज्योतिस्: ज्योतिस् n. (-तिः) 1 Light. 2 A star. 3 The pupil of the eye. m. (-तिः) 1 The sun. 2 AGNI or fire. E. द्युत् to shine, to be or give light, इसिन् Uṇādi affix, and ज substituted for the radical initial.
ज्योतिस्सात्: ज्योतिस्सात् ind. In flame or fire. E. ज्योतिस्, and साति aff.
ज्योतीरथ: ज्योतीरथ m. (-थः) The pole star, or in mythology DHRUVA, the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA. E. ज्योतिस् a star, and रथ a vehicle.
ज्योत्स्ना: ज्योत्स्ना f. (-त्स्ना) 1 Moonlight. 2 A moonlight night. 3 A small cucumber: see ज्योत्स्नी. E. ज्योतिस् light, त affix, and the penultimate rejected deriv. irr. fem. affix टाप्; also with ङिप्, ज्योत्स्नी q. v.
ज्योत्स्नाप्रिय: ज्योत्स्नाप्रिय m. (-यः) The Cakora or Greek partridge. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, and प्रिय fond of; this bird is said to feed upon the moonbeams.
ज्योत्स्नावृक्ष: ज्योत्स्नावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The tripod or tree of a lampstand, a candlestick. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, (put for lamp-light,) and वृक्ष a tree.
ज्योत्स्नी: ज्योत्स्नी f. (-त्स्नी) 1 A moonlight night. 2 A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diæca;) it is also applied to Luffa acutangula, &c. 3 A kind of perfume: see रेणुका. E. see ज्योत्स्ना.
ज्यौतिषिक: ज्यौतिषिक m. (-कः) An astrologer. E. ज्योतिस् a star, affix टक्; also the vowel being unchanged optionally, ज्योतिषिक.
ज्यौत्स्न: ज्यौत्स्न mfn. (-त्स्नः -त्स्नी -त्स्नं) Light, especially with moonlight, &c. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, अण् affix: see ज्यौत्स्नी and ज्यौत्स्निका.
ज्यौत्स्निका: ज्यौत्स्निका f. (-का) A moonlight. E. ज्योत्स्नी and कन्.
ज्यौत्स्नी: ज्यौत्स्नी f. (-त्स्नी) A moonlight night, or a night on which the moon is full. 2 A kind of cucumber: see ज्यौत्स्ना. E. ज्योत्ली as above, and अण् pleonastic aff.
ज्रि: ज्रि r. 1st cl. (ज्रियति) 1 To conquer, to reduce. 2 To be conquered or reduced.
ज्री: ज्री r. 1st cl. (ज्रिणाति) r. 1st and 10th cls. (ज्रयति-ज्राययति) To grow old, to be or become old or decayed.
ज्वर: ज्वर r. 1st cl. (ज्वरति) To be diseased, to be feverish, &c.
ज्वर m. (-रः) Fever, intermitting or continued. E. ज्वर to be feverish, affix अच्.
ज्वरघ्न: ज्वरघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Anti-febrile, febrifuge. f. (-घ्नी) 1 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 2 A potherb, (Chenopocium album.) E. ज्वर, and घ्न what destroys.
ज्वरनाशक: ज्वरनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Febrifuge. E. ज्वर, and नाशक what destroys.
ज्वरहन्तृ: ज्वरहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Febrifuge. E. ज्वर, and हन्तृ what destroys; ज्वरहन् (-च्चा).
ज्वराग्नि: ज्वराग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Feverish heat, or the hot paroxysm of fever. E. ज्वर fever, and अग्नि fire.
ज्वरान्तक: ज्वरान्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Febrifuge. m. (-कः) 1 A kind of Nimb from Nepal. 2 Cassia fistula. E. ज्वर, and अन्तक what removes.
ज्वरापहा: ज्वरापहा f. (-हा) A plant, (Medicago esculenta.) E. ज्वर fever, अपहा removing.
ज्वरित: ज्वरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Febrile, feverish, affected with fever. E. ज्वर to be feverish, क्त aff.
ज्वरिन्: ज्वरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Febrile, feverish, fevered. E. ज्वर, and इनि.
ज्वल: ज्वल r. 1st cl. (ज्वलति,) or with a prefix, r. 10th cl. (प्रज्वलयति) To shine, to blaze, to flame.
ज्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blazing, shining. m. (-लः) Flame, blaze, light. E. ज्वल, to blaze, affix अच्; also ज्वाल.
ज्वलका: ज्वलका f. (-का) Flame. E. ज्वल to blaze, affix वुन्.
ज्वलत्: ज्वलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Burning, blazing. 2 Shining, radiant, brilliant. E. ज्वल to burn, शतृ aff.
ज्वलन: ज्वलन n. (-नं) 1 Burning, blazing. 2 The fire. m. (-नः) AGNI, or fire. E. ज्वल to blaze, affix ल्युट्.
ज्वलनाश्मन्: ज्वलनाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) The sun-stone. E. ज्वलन, and अश्मन् a stone.
ज्वलन्मणि: ज्वलन्मणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Blazing with jewels. m. (-णिः) A brilliant gem. E. ज्वलत्, and मणि a jewel.
ज्वलयत्: ज्वलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Burning, blazing. 2 Radiant. E. ज्वल to burn, r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.
ज्वलित: ज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Burnt. 2 Blazing, flaming. E. ज्वल to flame, affix क्त.
ज्वलितनयन: ज्वलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fiery-eyed, looking angrily or fiercely. E. ज्वलित, and नयन the eye; also ज्वलितचक्षुस्, ज्वलितनेत्र, &c.
ज्वलिन्: ज्वलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Burning, flaming. 2 Shining. E. ज्वल, and इनि aff.
ज्वाल: ज्वाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Burning, blazing. mf. (-लः-ला) Flame, blaze. f. (-ला) Burnt rice. E. ज्वल to blaze, affix अण्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.
ज्वालाग्नि: ज्वालाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Flame. E. ज्वाल, and अग्नि fire.
ज्वालाजिहू: ज्वालाजिहू m. (-ह्वः) AGNI, or fire. E. जाला, and जिह्वा a tongue; whose tongue is flame.
ज्वालामुखी: ज्वालामुखी f. (-खी) A place where subterraneous fires break forth; an object of veneration to the Hindus: a celebrated Jvālāmukhī exists in Lahore, to which pilgrimages are made; the soil abounding with carburetted hydrogen, which takes fire upon coming in contact with the external air; otherwise vents being made, a light is applied to the orifice, and flame being kindled, is fed by the stream of gas that escapes. The tongue of PĀRVATĪ is said to have fallen at this place. E. ज्वाला flame, and मुख chief, principal, fem. affix ङीष्.
ज्वालिन्: ज्वालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Flaming, blazing. E. ज्वाला, and इनि aff. झ
